41000100423.name: From Substitute Bride to Beloved Wife
41000100423.synopsis: Mabel was originally the daughter of the wealthy Grant family. However, her happy family was torn apart when she was eight. Since then, her days were hard and challenging.
41000100423.title: From Substitute Bride to Beloved Wife

41000100669.name: Revenge Marriage Sweet Love
41000100669.synopsis: Cate's sister Rebecca had not only stolen her boyfriend Ethan, but had also stripped her of her inheritance. Fueled by desire for revenge, a drunken Cate impulsively decided to seduce Ethan's handsome uncle, Shaun, who later was ignited by Cate and fell madly in love despite his cold demeanor. However, when they both realized Shaun was mistaken as Ethan's uncle, Shaun realized that she initially approached him only for revenge against Ethan, putting their love to the test.
41000100669.title: Revenge Marriage Sweet Love

41000100700.name: Dark Web of Desire
41000100700.synopsis: Sold out by someone in dark web, Chloe Morgan bumps into mafia lord, Shaun Luther in the riches’ hunting game. Once an aristocracy, Chloe is now dragged into inferno by Shaun, lost in sweetness and tortures. She finally makes up her mind to leave, but Shaun confines her no matter how many times she tries. It’s out of love, or of hatred? Overwhelmed by love and forbidden desire, the two hurt each other but simultaneously save each other.
41000100700.title: Dark Web of Desire

41000100701.name: Rebel in Devil's Shackle
41000100701.synopsis: Sold out by someone in dark web, Nina Morgan bumps into mafia lord, Max Luther in the riches’ hunting game. Once an aristocracy, Nina is now dragged into inferno by Max, lost in sweetness and tortures. She finally makes up her mind to leave, but Max confines her no matter how many times she tries. It’s out of love, or of hatred? Overwhelmed by love and forbidden desire, the two hurt each other but simultaneously save each other.
41000100701.title: Rebel in Devil's Shackle

41000100743.name: Hi, Mr. Capricious
41000100743.synopsis: On the day of Aiden Steele's engagement to Isabella Rosewood, Emma Blake was forced into abortion by Aiden’s mother. As the mistress, she was deemed unworthy to bear children for the Steele family.
41000100743.title: Hi, Mr. Capricious

41000100803.name: Love Blooms in Contracted Hearts
41000100803.synopsis: One tipsy night at a company getaway, Cecilia Caine and Liam Lamberth unexpectedly hooked up. However, she was aware that the CEO had feelings for someone else, so she quietly slipped away, thinking their night meant nothing. Little did she know, Liam had different plans—he wanted to marry her. Desperate for cash, Cecilia reluctantly agreed and endured his unreasonable demands.
41000100803.title: Love Blooms in Contracted Hearts

41000100805.name: Ark on Time
41000100805.synopsis: Resurrected, she will reclaim both her love and career. She will make those who intend to harm her suffer the consequences of their actions. She will remain with her beloved husband until the end of time.
41000100805.title: Ark on Time

41000100807.name: Spoiling My Sweet Wife to Her Core
41000100807.synopsis: On the day of the engagement, Anne Miller was framed in a cheating scandal. Her fiance, Shawn Smith, was furious and vowed never to marry Anne. She knew that her pretentious step-sister, Elsa Miller, was the mastermind behind it all. Shawn believed entirely in Elsa's lies. Devastated, Anne died with resentment and regret.A soul of a heroine—who shared the same name as Anne—transmigrated into Anne Miller's body and swore to avenge her.
41000100807.title: Spoiling My Sweet Wife to Her Core

41000100811.name: Serendipitous Love
41000100811.synopsis: The day Sylvia Cooper joined Taylor Corp. marked the day she was wedded to a total stranger named Brian Anders, who promptly disappeared right after they signed the marriage papers.A year later, Liam Taylor, the CEO of Taylor Corp., returned from France.Over time, Liam found himself harboring unique emotions for Sylvia. Liam was also pursuing a divorce. When he arrived at the Courthouse, standing patiently waiting at the entrance was none other than Sylvia…
41000100811.title: Serendipitous Love （DUBBED)

41000100822.name: Pampered by Him
41000100822.synopsis: Lia was arranged a blind date by her stepmother. To teach the guy a lesson, Lia caught a handsome guy, Jeremy, and kissed him in front of the man. Although the man left her angrily, she found herself trapped in bigger trouble. That man was the famous President of the Smith Group, Jeremy Smith, at the cafe to meet his contract bride. However, she did not show up, and Lia snatched his first kiss instead.
41000100822.title: Pampered by Him

41000100828.name: Mr. Moore's Secret Wife
41000100828.synopsis: Sapphire Wyatt's family was framed and tortured by Logan Moore. Her life became even miserable when she was eventually forced to marry her tormentor. Logan’s exact words were, "Sapphire Wyatt, even in death, you would be subjected to my approval!"
41000100828.title: Mr. Moore's Secret Wife

41000100832.name: She’s the Apple of Their Eye
41000100832.synopsis: Emily, the daughter of the illustrious Porter family, had her world upended when she learned she wasn't her parents' biological daughter. When the true Porter family heiress returned to claim her birthright, Emily was kicked out of the family. After rejoining her biological family, she discovered she was the heiress of the nation's wealthiest dynasty. She had five exceptional brothers who showered her with affection, two adoring parents, and a wealthy CEO fiancé.
41000100832.title: She’s the Apple of Their Eye

41000100836.name: Sweetheart Wife
41000100836.synopsis: Four years ago, Queenie Young was framed by Sandy Young and driven abroad by her father. She coincidentally rescued Shane Lawson abroad.Returning home four years later, Queenie found her fiance, Sam Fowler, cheating on her with Sandy. She impulsively married her best friend, Xander Lawson, but Xander took the wrong ID card because he was drunk. They accidentally registered Queenie's marriage with the male lead, Shane.
41000100836.title: Sweetheart Wife

41000100843.name: Spoiled by My Husband, Whom I Married Unintentionally
41000100843.synopsis: Quincy Yates endured a childhood of neglect. Her parents planned to marry her off to a wealthy old man. During her escape from this unwanted future, Quincy's path intersected with that of James Xavier, the CEO of Xavier Corp. With his help, she confronted her contemptuous parents and reprimanded her scheming foster sister. Ultimately, she discovered that she was the long-lost daughter of the esteemed Harrison family, destined to find wealth in both love and familial bonds!
41000100843.title: Spoiled by My Husband, Whom I Married Unintentionally

41000100855.name: The Lovers' Saga
41000100855.synopsis: When Carmelia Sanders stepped in for Maeve Turner at the After Hours Club, a twist of fate led her into a night with Asher Lowery. However, Maeve took credit for Carmelia's encounter with Asher. Asher woke up and found the pendant that Carmelia had left behind, becoming convinced that Maeve was the daughter of his savior. He deeply adored Maeve and even promised to make her his bride.
41000100855.title: The Lovers' Saga

41000100870.name: A Woman Scorned
41000100870.synopsis: Carynn Hughes was always the black sheep of her family. Her father did not like her, her stepmother was cruel, and her stepsister seduced her fiancee, Archiebald Murray. After a chance encounter with the powerful Jayden Lewis and his ill grandfather on the same day, she was given the opportunity to start a new life. Although her parents blamed her for Archiebald’s affair with her stepsister, Carynn manages to turn them into the town’s laughingstock during their engagement.
41000100870.title: A Woman Scorned

41000100888.name: The Scheming Maid
41000100888.synopsis: 20 years ago, Emma Harrison, the privileged daughter of a wealthy family, enjoyed a life that many envied. However, their world crumbled due to the meddling of a private tutor, Therese Parish. Emma's father became entangled in an affair, her younger brother tragically passed away, and her mother suffered a severe breakdown, shattering their once-happy family.Emma swore to herself that she would definitely make Therese pay back for all the suffering she inflicted on her.
41000100888.title: The Scheming Maid

41000100891.name: Married a Secret Millionaire as a Substitute
41000100891.synopsis: In order to pay for her mother's medical expenses, Olivia Walker, the illegitimate child of the Walker family, marries a poor ex-convict in place of her sister. She has no idea that this man is, in fact, Andrew Smith, the richest person in Cascadia. Their lives then take a sweet but dangerous turn.
41000100891.title: Married a Secret Millionaire as a Substitute

41000100895.name: The Spoiled Wife Is Acting Up Again
41000100895.synopsis: Anna Brown is schemed against by her stepmother and stepsister on her wedding eve and loses her innocence after a one-night stand with a stranger. Unexpectedly, the man who spent the one-night stand with Anna, Henry Garcia, is the man Anna’s stepsister desires to wed. With Henry as her greatest sword and shield, Anna finds her way back to the pinnacle of the entertainment industry, achieving success in both her personal and professional life.
41000100895.title: The Spoiled Wife Is Acting Up Again

41000100902.name: Nothing Else Compares
41000100902.synopsis: Shawn Moore locked Kesia Foster up in an asylum, torturing and humiliating her to no end, making her pay for her father’s sin of causing his father’s death.Two years later, he married her, but… “You’re just paying for your family’s sins in another way.”
41000100902.title: Nothing Else Compares

41000101854.name: Flash Marriage with My Werewolf Husband
41000101854.synopsis: To escape her abusive stepfather, Lisa takes the offer from a law firm in New York, where she unexpectedly flash-marries her boss. As she juggles work, she wants to bring the werewolf who once attacked her to justice, her boss becomes more and more suspicious… Caught between his mounting suspicion and her undeniable attraction to him, Lisa struggles with her next move.
41000101854.title: Flash Marriage with My Werewolf Husband

41000101912.name: Shadowed Thrones
41000101912.synopsis: Felix Young, known as the Supreme, discreetly supports his wife, Madison Xavier, in her ascent to a higher position. However, the day she is appointed as the War God, Madison files for divorce. Disheartened, Felix is determined to reclaim everything he once granted her.
41000101912.title: Shadowed Thrones

41000102472.name: Fortunes Unveiled: My Husband Is a Big Shot
41000102472.synopsis: On the first day of Chinese New Year, Jay Wade pays a visit to his wife's family, only to be ill-treated with contempt. Little do they know that Jay is, in fact, the chairman of Win Corp, one of the top ten companies in the world.
41000102472.title: Fortunes Unveiled: My Husband Is a Big Shot

41000102609.name: Back to the 80s
41000102609.synopsis: Julie Stein wakes up from her sleep, expecting just another ordinary day. However, to her surprise, she finds herself in the 80s, a totally different era from where she belongs. Not only is she a disowned daughter of a wealthy family to whom she has no blood connection, but she is also supposed to marry an old man with two children, in place of the family’s biological daughter.
41000102609.title: Back to the 80s

41000102743.name: Supremacy Unbound: Ascending Above All
41000102743.synopsis: Once a great and powerful Lord of Valor, Maxwell Kane now finds himself grappling with the loss of his memory, leading a hard life toiling away on construction sites. Despite his hardships, he perseveres and tries his best to cope with life, but all sorts of injustices set him back like tides of cruelty.However, fate takes an unexpected turn when he encounters a gorgeous woman named Samantha Claude.
41000102743.title: Supremacy Unbound: Ascending Above All

41000102810.name: Return of the Dominant Queen
41000102810.synopsis: Layla Moore, formerly the second-in-command at Seradel Palace, moved to Redville with her daughter, Clara Moore. Six months ago, Clara married Harry Chase, who has subjected her to abuse and violence. Not only is Harry a poor husband, but he also conspires with a bandit named Michael Kane for personal gain. As word of their schemes spreads, Layla returns to Seradel, reclaiming her throne as queen to save her daughter and thwart Michael's conspiracy once and for all.
41000102810.title: Return of the Dominant Queen

41000102839.name: A Breath Away From Forever
41000102839.synopsis: Five years ago, Callista Summers rescued Jeremiah Fuller when he was drugged. She then pursued her career abroad, driven by her initial self-doubt as a housekeeper. Over time, Callista became a renowned designer and a devoted mother to her son, Scotty Fuller. When she learns of Jeremiah’s kidney failure, she selflessly returns to donate her kidney, saving him once more. However, misunderstandings breed animosity between them.
41000102839.title: A Breath Away From Forever

41000102849.name: The Unrivaled Overlord
41000102849.synopsis: Theo Larsen, alias the Overlord, commands a Wolf Army of a million strong. Shrouding his identity, he ties the knot with Sarah Welsh, the daughter of the prosperous Welsh family, securing the future of Glory Group before ascending to the pinnacle of his life.
41000102849.title: The Unrivaled Overlord

41000102960.name: Rising Dawn: The Awakening of Power
41000102960.synopsis: Aidan Stein, the Eternal Lord Sovereign of the magnificent Eternity Palace, temporarily loses his memory and intelligence due to his 60-year cycle. He lives alone in Vertania until he encounters Jade Yule, who saves his life and becomes his wife. Years later, Jack Foley, an aristocrat of Vertania, develops an interest in Jade. He sends his men after Aidan, inadvertently triggering the resurgence of his memories and power.
41000102960.title: Rising Dawn: The Awakening of Power

41000103082.name: How to Snatch a Billionaire
41000103082.synopsis: Tired of dull blind dates, Harley impulsively kisses a handsome stranger passing by. But he won't let go easily, sparking an unexpected romantic encounter.
41000103082.title: How to Snatch a Billionaire

41000103356.name: One Fateful Night with My Boss
41000103356.synopsis: After having a one-night stand with an old geezer for money, Anita said goodbye to this cold city and went abroad. Six years later, she comes back with her son and bumps into the legendary CEO, Tristan, who later turns out to be her new boss. Before she knows it, her son starts calling this handsome new boss: “dad”. Could this be fate?
41000103356.title: One Fateful Night with My Boss

41000103453.name: Love's Trenches
41000103453.synopsis: Mia Bale, the daughter of the wealthiest family, works as an intern in her family's company. Unexpectedly, she encounters Ken Leed, the CEO of a collaborating company who is also her former boyfriend, having vanished without explanation three years ago. As Mia tries to reconcile with Ken, she faces obstacles from Lily Cork, who exacerbates misunderstandings between them.
41000103453.title: Love's Trenches

41000103524.name: Fortunes Unveiled: My Husband Is a Big Shot
41000103524.synopsis: On the first day of Chinese New Year, Jay Wade pays a visit to his wife's family, only to be ill-treated with contempt. Little do they know that Jay is, in fact, the chairman of Win Corp, one of the top ten companies in the world.
41000103524.title: Fortunes Unveiled: My Husband Is a Big Shot（DUBBED）

41000103539.name: Alpha’s Perfect Love
41000103539.synopsis: Alpha Liam finds out that his mate, Dora, is a regular human who hates werewolves to her guts. To be with her, Liam keeps his werewolf identity a secret and pretends to be a regular human, not knowing that a mystery child is going to reveal a deep secrete of them from 5 years ago…
41000103539.title: Alpha’s Perfect Love

41000103670.name: Trails of Hope: His Journey Back Home
41000103670.synopsis: Theo Levy lost contact with his parents 20 years ago due to a car accident. Fortunately, he was adopted by the chairman of Boyd Group, who raised him into the man he is today. Now that he has finally returned to his hometown, he swears to find his biological parents with the pendant he has.
41000103670.title: Trails of Hope: His Journey Back Home

41000103781.name: Fated to My Cruel CEO
41000103781.synopsis: Helen and Algar escaped an orphanage and embarked on separate journeys, with only their hearts connected by a promise that refuses to break. A fated reunion filled with love, secrets and echoes of their past.
41000103781.title: Fated to My Cruel CEO

41000103801.name: Ablaze With Vengeance
41000103801.synopsis: Years ago, Layla York, Balton’s Valkyrie, believed Sean Groff had saved her life, and that belief led to their marriage. Over the past three years, she has devoted herself to him and his family, aiding in his ascent to prominence and facilitating his entry into the Onyx Group. She plans to announce his appointment as CEO during the Phoenix Gala.
41000103801.title: Ablaze With Vengeance

41000103931.name: My Heartless Alpha
41000103931.synopsis: Rejected by her mate and cast out of her werewolf pack, Avery meets Ryan, the feared Alpha of the largest wolf pack in America. Despite the rumor of him being heartless, she finds herself falling for him, with an uncertain fate ahead.
41000103931.title: My Heartless Alpha

41000103960.name: At Her Behest: The Lady's Dominion
41000103960.synopsis: Released from a three-year imprisonment in jail in place of her boyfriend, Jim Norman, Ciara Lopez learns that she is the Lady of Dragon Hall. She plans to marry Jim, but he is set to wed her best friend, Fanny Todd. Meanwhile, Ciara discovers that her father has endured harassment from loan sharks for the past three years because of her. Determined to uncover the truth, she visits the Emperor Hotel and witnesses Jim’s cold-bloodedness firsthand.
41000103960.title: At Her Behest: The Lady's Dominion

41000104043.name: The Dominant Heir's Triumphant Return
41000104043.synopsis: Sean York is born into a respected family. For the past three years, he has been in a relationship with Mia Leed. But he gets injured in a car accident and falls into a coma. For his sake, Mia works multiple jobs to pay for his medical bills. Mia's relatives often mock and tease her. They introduce Mia to the son of a wealthy family. However, as Mia resists, Sean wakes up. To return her favor, Sean reclaims his title with his parents and confronts those who have wronged Mia.
41000104043.title: The Dominant Heir's Triumphant Return

41000104125.name: Trails of Hope: His Journey Back Home
41000104125.synopsis: Theo Levy lost contact with his parents 20 years ago due to a car accident. Fortunately, he was adopted by the chairman of Boyd Group, who raised him into the man he is today. Now that he has finally returned to his hometown, he swears to find his biological parents with the pendant he has.
41000104125.title: Trails of Hope: His Journey Back Home（DUBBED）

41000104164.name: Ascension to the Lost Throne
41000104164.synopsis: After defeating the Killer Sect, the Lord of War, Harry White, is forced to leave the War Sect with his wife due to family conflicts. Unexpectedly, the Killer Sect rejuvenates and collaborates with Harry’s brother, John White, to take him down. Even Harry’s wife betrays him and stands against him. Thanks to Mary Norris, Harry stands a chance to win this battle.
41000104164.title: Ascension to the Lost Throne

41000104219.name: Mafia's Good Girl
41000104219.synopsis: Abducted by the mafia king, innocent Bella was forced to sign a contract with him in order to pay for her mother’s surgery. However, this contract that’s worthy of half a million dollars requires much more from Bella than she has ever imagined… The mafia king’s hardcore outer shell is slowly getting softened by Bella, while Bella gradually discovers her true self as well. But is it love, or just Stockholm syndrome?
41000104219.title: Mafia's Good Girl

41000104224.name: Masked Magnate: The Dominant Son-in-Law
41000104224.synopsis: After being reunited with his biological father, Chris Bell assumes the CEO position at the Olgow branch of Apex Group. However, at his father-in-law's birthday party, he faces rejection from the family table, labeled as a useless live-in son-in-law. His challenges escalate as his wife faces disdain alongside him, a suitor tries to take her away, developers attempt to forcibly demolish their home, and his daughter falls victim to a brutal attack by a wealthy man.
41000104224.title: Masked Magnate: The Dominant Son-in-Law

41000104235.name: Awakened: His Absolute Might Unleashed
41000104235.synopsis: Cade Leed raises his sick younger sister, Amy Leed, on his own despite his young age. Though it breaks his heart, Cade has no choice but to put her up for adoption, hoping that a family with resources can provide the treatment she needs. Twenty years later, Cade falls into a coma after an accident, and his fiancée, Rue Kirk, cares for him tirelessly for five years, never giving up hope.
41000104235.title: Awakened: His Absolute Might Unleashed

41000104355.name: Rejected Luna's Prince
41000104355.synopsis: Rejected by her mate upon discovering her pregnancy, Willa leaves the Blue Ridge Pack to raise her son, Emmett, alone. Meanwhile, her fated mate, Prince Dracos, embarks on a relentless quest to find her. Will their love conquer the secrets and dangers that threaten their future?
41000104355.title: Rejected Luna's Prince

41000104481.name: The Heiress and Her Three Princes
41000104481.synopsis: Just as Ria hits her rock bottom in life with her boyfriend cheating and her step-sister bullying, three handsome billionaires come to her save. They offer her a multi-billion inheritance! But, under one condition…… She has to marry one of the three brothers to be the heiress. Who is she going to choose? And who would be YOUR pick?
41000104481.title: The Heiress and Her Three Princes

41000104494.name: Love's Detour to Destiny
41000104494.synopsis: Mia Cole has been married to Joe Holt for three years when she catches him in bed with Sue Cole on the day of their third wedding anniversary. After seeking a divorce, Mia reclaims her title as the founder of MY Corp and overcomes Sue, resolving the misunderstandings between herself and Joe. Having gone through thick and thin together, they finally end up as a happy couple.
41000104494.title: Love's Detour to Destiny

41000104560.name: Years of Dedication: Her Path to Glory
41000104560.synopsis: In the pressure-cooker town of Cluville, college entrance exam results are a matter of life and death—socially, that is. On announcement day, rumors swirl around Dave and Sue Cole. Sue's results are shrouded in secrecy, sparking whispers and scorn from the judgmental villagers. But what if Sue's hidden score holds a truth that could shatter expectations and send shockwaves across the nation?
41000104560.title: Years of Dedication: Her Path to Glory

41000104612.name: Cherished by My Exhusband's Brother
41000104612.synopsis: A full-time housewife, Chloe, who is left penniless after being betrayed by herhusband Phillip on her 30th birthday, finds solace and support in her secret admirer,her younger brother-in-law Vernon. With his help, she rebuilds her confidence and achieves success in both love and career.
41000104612.title: Cherished by My Exhusband's Brother

41000105010.name: Her Journey Beyond the Script
41000105010.synopsis: Charlotte Chase has been whisked into a romance novel! Unfortunately, she takes the role of the antagonist whose every move and decision is rife with… well, stupidity. It is apparent that "Charlotte Chase" was only written to show how much better the Female Lead is. Her inescapable ending, as decided by the book, is death.Charlotte knows she has to get out of the Male Lead, Fred's, life before she is dragged into a whirlwind of power plays and conspiracies.
41000105010.title: Her Journey Beyond the Script

41000105040.name: Chasing My Rejected Wife
41000105040.synopsis: Love, lies, and mistaken identities! … As Aileen Smith navigated her new life at work, she unexpectedly fell deeply for her boss—THE BILLIONAIRE. But Aileen had been married for a year, although she and her husband's encounters were so scarce they could barely recall each other's faces. Through a series of jaw-dropping twists, Aileen was stunned to discover that the captivating CEO was, in fact, her husband...
41000105040.title: Chasing My Rejected Wife

41000105041.name: The Return of the Unwanted Wife
41000105041.synopsis: I made a deal with the demon for the man I love to reach his peak. The price was harsh: should he never love me in return, I’d have to give up my own life. Yet, after five years of marriage, my hope that his heart might soften towards me shattered completely. Instead of the love I yearned for, I was served divorce papers, a cold reminder of my failure. The demon came to collect its due, but in the twist of fate, a soul sacrificed her own to restore mine. Now that I’m back…
41000105041.title: The Return of the Unwanted Wife

41000105143.name: Hidden Hero: His Time to Shine
41000105143.synopsis: As Logant’s top researcher, Nathan Kent takes part in the Kunst Program, a secret national security operation. All participants unselfishly devote themselves to the operation for the good of the country. However, when Nathan’s teacher dies from exhaustion, a top celebrity and his assistant ask Nathan to empty the ward and even humiliate him.
41000105143.title: Hidden Hero: His Time to Shine

41000105193.name: After Divorce: I Become Heiress
41000105193.synopsis: In order to get rid of her billionaire father’s overwhelming love, Sally hid her real identity as the wealthy heiress and chose to make her own living. Her husband Felix cheats on her. In retaliation, Sally married Aiden in a flash. Unknown to her, Aiden is CEO of Taylor family. After the divorce, Sally chose to reveal her identity but was jeered by Felix and others. Aiden didn’t believe her either. But when would Sally and Aiden know their real identities?
41000105193.title: After Divorce: I Become Heiress

41000105195.name: Harvest of Ambition: A CEO's Odyssey
41000105195.synopsis: After five years of working hard in the city, Derek Larsen becomes the CEO of Gilmore Group and orders the acquisition of all unsold vegetables in Ashville. Unexpectedly, his actions are met with doubt and mockery from his family and acquaintances instead of appreciation. His wife, Nina Hart, arrives to meet him in her secret lover, Simon Hall’s, car and claims that the acquisition is Simon’s deed.
41000105195.title: Harvest of Ambition: A CEO's Odyssey

41000105199.name: One Night to Forever
41000105199.synopsis: After a one-night stand with Layla Reed, Miles Zeller takes her snowflake necklace and instructs his men to treat her as his future wife. However, his subordinate mistakenly identifies Lana Reed as Layla, sparking a competition between the real Layla and the impostor for the title of Mrs. Zeller.
41000105199.title: One Night to Forever

41000105242.name: Wait, My Secretary Is My Wife?!
41000105242.synopsis: Thanks to Sam Good’s grandmother, Sam Good and Sue Judd get married despite knowing very little about each other. After their wedding, they part ways and only reunite a year later at Sam's election event for secretary, where Sue becomes his personal secretary. Remarkably, neither of them recognizes the other. Despite several attempts by Lana Bale and Sam’s mother to sabotage their relationship, Sam and Sue gradually fall for each other.
41000105242.title: Wait, My Secretary Is My Wife?!

41000105284.name: Whirlwind Vows: The Storm of Love
41000105284.synopsis: After her father ends up in a vegetative state, Sophie Lush is tricked by her stepmother and stepsister into sleeping with a stranger, then kicked out of her home. To pay for her father’s medical bills, she sells the ring left behind by the stranger, not knowing that he is Colin Reid, the CEO of Mirage Corp. Unbeknownst to her, Colin searches for her for years but fails to track her down.
41000105284.title: Whirlwind Vows: The Storm of Love

41000105313.name: The Dominant Heir's Triumphant Return
41000105313.synopsis: Sean York is born into a respected family. For the past three years, he has been in a relationship with Mia Leed. But he gets injured in a car accident and falls into a coma. For his sake, Mia works multiple jobs to pay for his medical bills. Mia's relatives often mock and tease her. They introduce Mia to the son of a wealthy family. However, as Mia resists, Sean wakes up. To return her favor, Sean reclaims his title with his parents and confronts those who have wronged Mia.
41000105313.title: The Dominant Heir's Triumphant Return（DUBBED）

41000105486.name: I'm the Rule
41000105486.synopsis: In a world where power reigns supreme, a mysterious Emperor of the mafias must navigate betrayal, love, and loyalty as he fights to maintain his iron grip on the criminal underworld, all while keeping his true identity hidden from those closest to him.
41000105486.title: I'm the Rule

41000105524.name: Winning Her Over a Second Time
41000105524.synopsis: Despite living with his girlfriend, Sally Nelson, for the past three years and being fully aware of her expectations for marriage, Quinton Young continually delays their potential marital bliss. Although it's clear to everyone that he loves Sally, he refuses to acknowledge their relationship. Eventually, Sally, frustrated by his reluctance, decides to leave him and turns to someone else for what he won’t give her.
41000105524.title: Winning Her Over a Second Time

41000105554.name: Mated with My Fiance's Alpha Daddy
41000105554.synopsis: Jessie finds herself in a perilous situation where she has been drugged and raped, only to be rescued by Alpha Andrew, who discovers they are mates. However, when Andrew attempts to establish a relationship with Jessie, she claims her engagement to another man. On her wedding with Derek, it turns out Andrew is her fiance's dad.... Where will this "forbidden love" manipulated by fate ultimately lead?
41000105554.title: Mated with My Fiance's Alpha Daddy

41000105758.name: Queen of the Battlefield: Her Return to Glory
41000105758.synopsis: Sophie Devin uses her formidable strength to defend the nation in honor of her father and brother, who lost their lives on the battlefield. However, for the sake of assuring her mother, she promises to hide her capabilities and stop involving herself in the battles. Instead, she marries Blake Jaffe, the man her mother has chosen for her, and embraces a life as an ordinary woman. On their wedding day, Blake leaves for a mission and returns only a year later.
41000105758.title: Queen of the Battlefield: Her Return to Glory

41000105806.name: Falling In Love with the Rascal in A Suit
41000105806.synopsis: Betty has to work two jobs for her mom. She is both a stripper and a hotel cleaner. One night, Marcus, the infamous mob boss, enters Betty’s club, hoping to regain his “man power”. Every woman is a disappointment, except for Betty. He falls for her instantly, not knowing that Betty’s friend, Anthony, is also willing to sacrifice everything for her. A choice had to be made. An overly domineering mobster or an innocent scion. Who would she choose?
41000105806.title: Falling In Love with the Rascal in A Suit

41000106038.name: The Unconquerable Sovereign
41000106038.synopsis: He was the Emperor of Constantine Hall, the man ranked first on the Global Martial Deity Ranking. Six years ago, he hid his true identity and married Meera to preserve Somerland’s prosperity. He was a delivery boy by day and a construction worker by night. The Markles mocked him for his lowly position in life, but he had a debt to pay. He silently endured the taunts because of this and for his young daughter's sake. Six years later, the world turned upside down.
41000106038.title: The Unconquerable Sovereign

41000106041.name: The World in My Grasp
41000106041.synopsis: To marry his girlfriend, Finn Cooper toils as a laborer, enduring long days and surviving on instant noodles to save money, all while facing the scorn of those around him. Deeply troubled by his circumstances, he wishes for strength beyond his current limits. To his astonishment, his wish is granted, but in an unexpected twist. Everyone else becomes as fragile as water, making him the strongest man alive on the planet.
41000106041.title: The World in My Grasp

41000106089.name: Spoiled by Four Billionaires
41000106089.synopsis: Yvonne, who had no family of her own, financially supported her boyfriend Josh through his college years. However, once Josh found success, he left her for Clair, a woman with deep pockets. Together, Josh and Clair made Yvonne's life miserable, not realizing that Yvonne was actually a lost daughter of the wealthy Hoffman family. When her three powerful brothers and her fiancé finally located her, they rallied to her side to help her exact revenge on Josh.
41000106089.title: Spoiled by Four Billionaires

41000106479.name: Double Contract Love
41000106479.synopsis: After a one-night stand, they accidentally reunite at the registry office and get married, pretending to be poor to each other after marriage. The heroine is constantly at war with the female antagonist to reclaim her mother's company, during which the hero's true identity gradually surfaces, triggering a series of conflicts and crises. In the process of reclaiming her mother's relics, their relationship heats up.
41000106479.title: Double Contract Love

41000106592.name: Mr.Right & Ms.Wrong
41000106592.synopsis: Tristan loses his sight in an accident and becomes emotional closed off and cold. Ashley, needing to care for her sick father, is forced into an arranged engagement with a blind Tristan. Mistaken for a servant, she endures his harsh treatment. But as they spend time together, their hearts begin to open, and an unexpected love grows between them, bringing healing and hope to their lives.
41000106592.title: Mr.Right & Ms.Wrong

41000106704.name: The Lost Heir: His Dawn of Reckoning
41000106704.synopsis: Troy Levin puts his heart and soul into designing a patent and gifts it to his fiancée, hoping it will earn her commendation from Traxon Group. Unbeknownst to him, she has already betrayed him and is plotting to break his leg to curry favor with a wealthy man. To his surprise, the chairwoman of Traxon Group identifies him as her long-lost son.
41000106704.title: The Lost Heir: His Dawn of Reckoning

41000106711.name: Beyond Betrayal: Her New Dawn
41000106711.synopsis: While concealing her identity as the world's top artist and the daughter of Jaxon's wealthiest family, Kate Snow embarks on a three-year relationship with Cedric Muhl. However, their bond shatters when Joan Larson, a manipulative woman, frames Kate to win Cedric for herself. Choosing to align with Joan for the sake of his family's future, Cedric humiliates Kate and even resorts to physical violence against her.
41000106711.title: Beyond Betrayal: Her New Dawn

41000106748.name: Goodbye Mr. Sampson
41000106748.synopsis: As her world descends into silence and her marriage crumbles, Lilian Carter faces a race against time to uncover deadly secrets and reclaim her identity before her past, and those who betrayed her, destroy her future.
41000106748.title: Goodbye Mr. Sampson

41000106749.name: Masked Magnate: The Dominant Son-in-Law
41000106749.synopsis: After being reunited with his biological father, Chris Bell assumes the CEO position at the Olgow branch of Apex Group. However, at his father-in-law's birthday party, he faces rejection from the family table, labeled as a useless live-in son-in-law. His challenges escalate as his wife faces disdain alongside him, a suitor tries to take her away, developers attempt to forcibly demolish their home, and his daughter falls victim to a brutal attack by a wealthy man.
41000106749.title: Masked Magnate: The Dominant Son-in-Law (DUBBED)

41000106806.name: Love at Midnight
41000106806.synopsis: After signing the divorce agreement, Stella determined to break free from the past. However, she met Dereck at a bar, a handsome and mysterious man whose appearance injected new sparks into the story. Dereck timely helped Stella out of trouble, and the relationship between the two began to heat up.
41000106806.title: Love at Midnight

41000106838.name: Veiled Secrets: A Love Unraveled
41000106838.synopsis: Sandra Steele, the illegitimate daughter of the prime minister, accidentally spends a night with the abstinent regent, Duke Joshua. She then finds out that she is pregnant with twins a month later. Facing the tragic death of her mother and the pressure from her father to become someone else's concubine, Sandra has no choice but to reveal her pregnancy, yet she is brutally beaten for it.
41000106838.title: Veiled Secrets: A Love Unraveled

41000106873.name: Awakened: His Absolute Might Unleashed
41000106873.synopsis: Cade Leed raises his sick younger sister, Amy Leed, on his own despite his young age. Though it breaks his heart, Cade has no choice but to put her up for adoption, hoping that a family with resources can provide the treatment she needs. Twenty years later, Cade falls into a coma after an accident, and his fiancée, Rue Kirk, cares for him tirelessly for five years, never giving up hope.
41000106873.title: Awakened: His Absolute Might Unleashed (DUBBED)

41000106982.name: Fist of Justice: The Hero Returns
41000106982.synopsis: After the Yale Martial Arts School is brutally attacked, Theo Yale is adopted by his father’s best friend, Max Wood. Now living under a new name to honor his mother’s dying wish, Theo secretly practices martial arts, driven by the desire to one day avenge his family. Eighteen years later, trouble arises when Darren Judd and his men attempt to abduct Theo’s friend.
41000106982.title: Fist of Justice: The Hero Returns

41000107076.name: Survive and Thrive: The Mute Consort
41000107076.synopsis: In her tumultuous childhood, Everly Swan and her mother endured relentless bullying and oppression at the hands of the matriarch, who even resorted to poisoning Everly, leaving her mute. Yet, in her darkest hour, a simple shared piece of candy sparks an unbreakable bond of friendship between two innocent children.Years later, driven by a fierce desire to protect her mother, Everly seeks high status, only to have her dignity trampled underfoot by her cruel half-sister.
41000107076.title: Survive and Thrive: The Mute Consort

41000107274.name: Waking Up Married To My Crush!
41000107274.synopsis: Jasmine awoke to find herself married her college crush Patrick – who is both handsome and wealthy! Yet, she quickly discovers that her marriage is sinking. A tragic accident had damaged her brain, erased the last few years of her life, trapping her at the age of 21. Determined not to spend her 25th year as a love-struck, subservient wife, Jasmine decides to reclaim her sparkle. This transformation gives Patrick a new perspective on Jasmine, he starts to fall in love with her
41000107274.title: Waking Up Married To My Crush!

41000107291.name: Rise and Reign: His Vengeful Reckoning
41000107291.synopsis: To repay his three sisters for taking him in, Kevin Shaw uses the power of Drakonis to help them achieve the pinnacle of success. However, their biological brother, Horace Shaw, wants to be the heir and orchestrates a betrayal. On the day of their success, they drug Kevin, stab him three times, and throw him from a tall building, creating a bloody scene witnessed by Kevin's fiancée, Gina Zimmer.
41000107291.title: Rise and Reign: His Vengeful Reckoning

41000107398.name: The Regret That Consumed Us
41000107398.synopsis: Ethan Gray’s life seems perfect—he has a beautiful wife and a charming daughter. His love for his wife runs deep, and even as the busy CEO of Gray Corp, he makes it a priority to care for their daughter, Lily. Though Lily rarely gets to spend time with her mother, she takes immense pride in her mother’s successful career. However, everything changes when Lily falls gravely ill.
41000107398.title: The Regret That Consumed Us

41000107457.name: Love Me All You Like
41000107457.synopsis: When an impulsive one-night stand leads to an unexpected pregnancy, Sara finds herself pulled into Elliot’s world of luxury and privilege. As he repeatedly steps in to help her—saving her from an ex, offering her a place to stay, and supporting her during family conflicts—their connection deepens. Despite their differences, Sara and Elliot decide to marry, confronting the realities of their contrasting worlds and discovering love where they least expected it.
41000107457.title: Love Me All You Like

41000107529.name: The Lost Heir: His Dawn of Reckoning
41000107529.synopsis: Troy Levin puts his heart and soul into designing a patent and gifts it to his fiancée, hoping it will earn her commendation from Traxon Group. Unbeknownst to him, she has already betrayed him and is plotting to break his leg to curry favor with a wealthy man. To his surprise, the chairwoman of Traxon Group identifies him as her long-lost son.
41000107529.title: The Lost Heir: His Dawn of Reckoning (DUBBED)

41000107530.name: All My Love, All for You
41000107530.synopsis: To raise money for her tuition, Mona Leed works as a courier, where she meets Jim Judd and unexpectedly becomes pregnant. Her family, however, plans to marry her off to an older man in exchange for 500 thousand dollars. Determined to escape her family’s control, Mona decides to keep the baby and refuses the arranged marriage. Learning of her situation and recognizing Mona’s innocence, Jim steps in, bringing her home and caring for her.
41000107530.title: All My Love, All for You

41000107542.name: The Best Mistake Ever
41000107542.synopsis: A nerdy but smart girl, NIA, has a one night stand with billion-dollar fashion empire Owner, JAMES, and he mistakes Nia’s best friend, SELINE, for the girl he found himself infatuated and had relations with. As Seline and Nia serve as his first and second assistant, the web of friendship and love gets beyond entangled…
41000107542.title: The Best Mistake Ever

41000107757.name: How to Divorce a Billionaire
41000107757.synopsis: A female lawyer is unexpectedly hired by her estranged billionaire husband to be his divorce attorney. Amidst a series of misunderstandings, they rediscover their feelings for each other.
41000107757.title: How to Divorce a Billionaire

41000107789.name: In the Snare of Love
41000107789.synopsis: To save her sister Nina from heart disease, Cheryl Snow asks Sean Hall for a cure and becomes his lover in the process. Worried that Cheryl will eventually win Sean’s heart, Sienna Zane conspires with Heath Clark to frame Cheryl, resulting in Nina’s death in the operating room. Devastated, Cheryl demands a breakup. It is then that Sean realizes he is already in love with her. Sean later investigates the circumstances surrounding Nina’s death.
41000107789.title: In the Snare of Love

41000107888.name: My Poor Husband is A Billionaire
41000107888.synopsis: Stella had a one-night stand with a stranger and mistook the man as someone who had plunged her into a prostitution scandal and ruined her life. Three years later, Stella married a man named Ethan in a flash and the two soon fell in love. However, gradually Stella found Ethan similar to the man three years ago. Even worse, Ethan had been hiding his CEO identity from Stella. Unable to accept the truth, Stella divorced Ethan.
41000107888.title: My Poor Husband is A Billionaire

41000108064.name: Signed, Sealed, Secretly Married
41000108064.synopsis: With the help of his grandfather, Dave Quinn marries Tessa Gray, a girl he does not know much about. After marriage, Tessa works in Quinn Corp as a cleaner and makes Dave promise to keep their relationship a secret from their colleagues. However, some of her colleagues show disdain towards her, especially Dave’s childhood sweetheart, Lana Harris, who has a crush on him. Out of jealousy, Lana sets Tessa up in an attempt to get rid of her, hoping to ruin her marriage with Dave.
41000108064.title: Signed, Sealed, Secretly Married

41000108068.name: Daddy Mommy Don't Divorce
41000108068.synopsis: Dexter, the president, and Lilian, a recent graduate, spend the night together after their families move to get a marriage license without ever meeting. Six years later, Dexter comes back from abroad and hires Lilian as his personal assistant. What they don’t know is they are husband and wife both trying to get a divorce from each other. But with the help of their adorable son Danny, the two will realize their destiny and gradually fall back in love.
41000108068.title: Daddy Mommy Don't Divorce

41000108407.name: Trapped in the Allure
41000108407.synopsis: Tanya Abell sells her virginity at a high price to Taylor Wayne in order to raise money for her sister’s medical treatment. One year later, she bumps into him at a gathering. Taylor recognizes her and traps her against the wall. She escapes and rushes back into the private room, only to be dragged back to Taylor by Jason, who tells her that the only person who has the cure to save her sister is Taylor.
41000108407.title: Trapped in the Allure

41000108539.name: The Divorced Housewife Turned CEO
41000108539.synopsis: Sharon Green, secretly the CEO of MF Group, hides her identity to avoid making her husband, Martin, feel insecure. Despite supporting him, she faces betrayal and humiliation. After divorcing him, she reveals her true identity at a gala, ends Martin’s business deal, and reclaims her power, proving she’s a strong, independent woman.
41000108539.title: The Divorced Housewife Turned CEO

41000109017.name: Love That Wasn't Meant to Last
41000109017.synopsis: Lana West spends her time with her first love, Ben Zimmer, instead of her boyfriend, Zane Cox, on their third anniversary. Unable to tolerate her actions any longer, Zane decides to break up with her and accept a job offer from a foreign company, Dale Corp. However, Lana remains oblivious to the problem and continues to cause trouble, constantly pushing Zane’s limits.
41000109017.title: Love That Wasn't Meant to Last

41000109056.name: Crowned in Love: The Mother of Three Big Shots
41000109056.synopsis: As a single mother, May Judd raises three exceptional sons on her own, despite the challenges posed by her family. On her father’s seventieth birthday, her mother invites her to return home for a gathering. However, during her visit, May encounters unwarranted hostility from her father and younger sisters. Undaunted, she stands up to their biases and ultimately discovers her own path to happiness.
41000109056.title: Crowned in Love: The Mother of Three Big Shots (DUBBED)

41000109074.name: Witch Magic:True Love's Kiss
41000109074.synopsis: Vivian, a bartender, catches the eye of the wealthy Davin Grayson. However, at their wedding, a drunken kiss from Davin's illegitimate brother, Hank, disrupts everything. Vivian realizes Hank looks like the man she saw in her dreams, and after their kiss, she discovers she has the power to talk things into reality.
41000109074.title: Witch Magic:True Love's Kiss

41000109091.name: Hurt Me,Love Me
41000109091.synopsis: Even though Katherine and Eric got married, Eric was still entangled with Riley, which caused Katherine great suffering. Despite her pain, Katherine endured it out of guilt and deep love. Unexpectedly, she became pregnant again, but Eric continued to neglect and hurt her. For the sake of their lost child, Katherine decided to divorce.
41000109091.title: Hurt Me,Love Me

41000110039.name: Desired by My Unknown Husband
41000110039.synopsis: Frank, a small-town boy, hastily married urbanite Andrew, chosen by his grandmotherly friends, without recognizing each other. Andrew disappeared after going abroad for work. A year later, Frank's boss, the wealthy and charming Andrew, pursued him, leading to an affair. The once-playboy Andrew learned commitment and restraint, while Frank, once betrayed, regained trust and learned to love freely. At the divorce site, Frank discovered his husband and boss were the same person.
41000110039.title: Desired by My Unknown Husband

41000110123.name: Reveal, Rise and Reign
41000110123.synopsis: Lance West generously supports his girlfriend, Lara Olson, throughout her academic journey. Thanks to his financial assistance, she successfully graduates and attains significant financial success, earning tens of millions annually. Despite Lance's unwavering support, Lara callously severs their relationship, citing the gap in their social statuses. However, in the wake of this heartbreak, fate intervenes.
41000110123.title: Reveal, Rise and Reign (DUBBED)

41000110197.name: A Contractual Marriage? Hell No!
41000110197.synopsis: Keira Snow wakes up in shock, realizing that she had forced herself onto Nolan Blair, the CEO of her company, the night before. Overcome with guilt and pressure, she considers quitting her job. But her heartless parents have other plans, pushing her into a marriage arrangement she has no say in. Reluctantly, Keira decides to go along with it.
41000110197.title: A Contractual Marriage? Hell No!

41000110205.name: She Came from the Abyss
41000110205.synopsis: In order to exact her revenge for her mother and older sister's death, Adel infiltrated the Bay family disguised as the maid Kris Frost. Her target? Jamie Suthern, who married into the Bay family. She gained others' trust, created conflict, seduced Tony Bay, and destroyed his marriage with Jamie. Jamie was smart, yet she was a lunatic. The two fought, and Adel was kicked out of the Bay family thrice, but she would always return.
41000110205.title: She Came from the Abyss

41000110283.name: The Runaway Heiress
41000110283.synopsis: The story of a rich girl, Veronica, who is about to marry her beloved fiancé, Logan, but Veronica realizes that Logan's love isn't real, but an elaborate scheme for the benefit of the family. Ellie has been secretly planning to take advantage of Veronica's status and wealth to marry into the family.
41000110283.title: The Runaway Heiress

41000110319.name: The Wedding Day Divorce
41000110319.synopsis: On Tyson Jordan’s wedding day, his sister, Taylor, returns from abroad to celebrate, only to be mistaken by his fiancée for his secret pregnant lover. Despite Taylor's attempts to clarify the misunderstanding, the fiancée harbors resentment and deliberately causes Taylor's miscarriage. When Tyson learns the truth, he vows to seek revenge for his sister, compelling his fiancée’s family to face the consequences of her reckless actions.
41000110319.title: The Wedding Day Divorce (DUBBED)

41000110433.name: When Forever Turns to Never
41000110433.synopsis: Can you imagine being humiliated by your future stepmother at your father’s wedding, only to be mistaken for his mistress? In this story, Luna Ward seizes the moment of this misunderstanding and turns it into an opportunity to expose her stepmother. As the scandal stirs the crowd, Luna defends her dignity and protects her family. With Julian Ward’s unwavering support, they unleash their fury, putting an end to the disgrace once and for all.
41000110433.title: When Forever Turns to Never

41000110445.name: Forever Was a Lie
41000110445.synopsis: Nicole Quinn is taken in by her mother’s best friend after her family goes bankrupt, beginning a 20-year bond with Colin and Abel from the Smith family. The brothers dote on Nicole, but everything changes when the nanny’s daughter, Mandy Moore, enters the picture. Nicole becomes the target of Mandy’s schemes and humiliation, placing her in a difficult situation where the Smith brothers start distancing themselves and lose interest in her.
41000110445.title: Forever Was a Lie

41000110515.name: Escape With Boss's Baby
41000110515.synopsis: Hermione Garcia is a famous computer genius and the heiress to the Garcia family,the wealthiest family in the South. She falls in love with Chris Evans, the President of LM Corporation, after he saves her at a banquet three years ago. To seek a genuine connection, Hermione conceals her identity and takes on the role of Chris's chief secretary, secretly dating him for three years.
41000110515.title: Escape With Boss's Baby

41000110648.name: What She Left Behind
41000110648.synopsis: After being transported back to an ancient era, Isla Stern devotes herself to helping Shaun Laine, a downtrodden prince, rise to power and become a great emperor. She gives birth to their cherished son, Aaron Laine, and earns her place as a revered empress admired by all. However, years later, both her husband and son fall for Tanya Yale, betraying her trust and breaking her heart.
41000110648.title: What She Left Behind

41000110709.name: Cause You Were Never Mine
41000110709.synopsis: When Jade's mother falls ill, Jade pretends to cheat with Dexter to avoid burdening Bruce, who was planning to propose. Heartbroken, Bruce breaks up with her. To revenge, Bruce starts his own business with the help of his family. Five years later, as CEO of Morgan Group, he hires Jade, thus beginning a love story of mutual torment that would touch hearts.
41000110709.title: Cause You Were Never Mine

41000110859.name: Come Back For You
41000110859.synopsis: After murdered by her ex-husband Ricky, Shannon reborn 10 years ago to start her revenge for Ricky and second chance love with Johnny Wonder.
41000110859.title: Come Back For You

41000110955.name: Falling Into Ceo's Embrace
41000110955.synopsis: In order to reject the marriage arranged by his grandmother, Lucas claims that he would only marry if a bride falls from the sky, as it would be God's will. At once, Michelle falls from a tree while trying to save a puppy. To accept 'God's will', Lucas and Michelle hastily get married and then he goes abroad. Michelle, who haven't seen Lucas for four years, falls in love with her boss Lucas at work but hesitates to confess, because of his married status....
41000110955.title: Falling Into Ceo's Embrace

41000110959.name: My Lovely Wife is a Big Shot
41000110959.synopsis: My Lovely Wife is Big Shot-A secretive runaway heiress and a billionaire disguised as a homeless man find themselves in a whirlwind marriage of mistaken identities, outrageous schemes, and laugh-out-loud chaos, as they battle power-hungry exes and uncover shocking truths—one mishap at a time.
41000110959.title: My Lovely Wife is a Big Shot

41000111140.name: Lion's Dawn
41000111140.synopsis: Leo was paralyzed and in a coma for three years after a car accident. Davina dropped out of school to care for him. Leo was secretly the heir to the Thorne Group and Brandohr family. During a fundraiser, Joseph tried to take Davina, but Leo woke up and called his family, who stopped Joseph. At their wedding, Davina’s relatives mocked Leo, but Cynthia and the Earl of Brandohr appeared, silencing everyone. Leo then proposed to Davina.
41000111140.title: Lion's Dawn

41000111513.name: I'm Nothing but a Mortal
41000111513.synopsis: Ian Colt, a genius Jade Sect apprentice, ascends to the Sky Realm after just 20 years of cultivation. Believing there's nothing more to teach him, his mentor, Sean Judd, tricks Ian into leaving for the mortal realm.There, Ian encounters Jim Cole, whose life is on the line. Despite the efforts of three skilled doctors, none can save him, leaving his daughter, Sue Cole, desperate. Ian successfully saves Jim.
41000111513.title: I'm Nothing but a Mortal (DUBBED)

41000111514.name: Moving On From You
41000111514.synopsis: Jane Rowe has been in love with Sam Bale ever since he took her in at the age of seven. Every year on her birthday, she confesses her feelings, only to be rejected as Sam, believing their ten-year age gap is too large, chooses someone else. One night, they get drunk and spend the night together, but Sam has no recollection of it. When Jane becomes pregnant, Sam accuses her of being indecent. Heartbroken, Jane leaves him to continue his life with his girlfriend.
41000111514.title: Moving On From You

41000111541.name: Carrying His Babies, Stealing His Heart
41000111541.synopsis: Ella Reed is a struggling college student who’s barely making ends meet. Desperate to cover her tuition, she accepts a one-night arrangement with Sebastian Harrington, a billionaire heir from an affluent family grappling with a legacy of infertility. When Ella discovers she’s pregnant with twins, Sebastian, eager to secure his family’s long-awaited heir, brings her into his luxurious world to ensure a safe and peaceful pregnancy.
41000111541.title: Carrying His Babies, Stealing His Heart

41000111652.name: Return of His Majesty
41000111652.synopsis: Before leaving his hometown, Leo Lowe makes a promise to his fiancée, Tina Leed, that once he becomes emperor, he will return to make her his empress. Years later, he successfully establishes a new dynasty and becomes the emperor of it, so he returns to the village disguised as an ordinary villager to fulfill his promise, not expecting to be forced to pay just to get through the entrance.
41000111652.title: Return of His Majesty (DUBBED)

41000111843.name: Tied to My Dangerous Mafia Husband
41000111843.synopsis: “Lauren, you're pregnant with twins..." Having lost her memory, Laurent returns to the country to search her father and foster brother with only a necklace as a clue. She thinks she could put up with Vivian and Jacob's harassment for the work visa, but all she got is nonstop abuse and insults. In a turn of fate, Laurent ends up spending another night with Ryan after being fired. "You're the Lor?"
41000111843.title: Tied to My Dangerous Mafia Husband

41000111946.name: Boss! U Almost Got Her
41000111946.synopsis: When childhood sweethearts arrange to reunite at a bridal shop after twenty years apart, a manipulative best friend steals the bride's place and her billionaire groom. Now working as his secretary, the real bride must navigate growing feelings for her boss while unaware he's her long-lost love - even as her friend rushes them toward a wedding built on lies.
41000111946.title: Boss! U Almost Got Her

41000112200.name: My Secret Agent Husband 2
41000112200.synopsis: After surviving the chaos of their first adventure, Lucas and his secret agent husband, Wyatt, finally settle into a new chapter of their lives. Lucas is thriving as CryptoLink's CEO, while Wyatt juggles his undercover missions. But just when they think they’ve found stability, old threats resurface, new betrayals unfold, and their long-awaited wedding is once again in jeopardy.
41000112200.title: My Secret Agent Husband 2

41000112267.name: Love at the End of Lies
41000112267.synopsis: On her engagement day, Ava discovers that her fiancé́ Dylan has secretly misused her savings. Instead of feeling guilty, Dylan and his mother insulted her, prompting her to call off the engagement in anger. In a desperate attempt to raise funds to save her grandmother's house, Ava agrees to marry Noah, the grandson of her elderly neighbor. Unknown to Ava, Noah is a billionaire who mistakenly believes Ava is a gold digger.
41000112267.title: Love at the End of Lies

41000112268.name: My Heart Dies From Home
41000112268.synopsis: From a young age,Greta was abandoned and forced to survive on her own. In her quest to claim her adoptive father's unpaid wages, she encountered ridicule and Mistreatment at the hands of the Walker family. Unbeknownst to the Walkers, they had been tirelessly searching for a family named Clara, not realizing that Greta, the very individual they had been disparaging, was Clara all along..
41000112268.title: My Heart Dies From Home

41000112431.name: Why Women Cheat
41000112431.synopsis: Frances,a housewife who is losing herself to her husband's control and contempt,falls in love with his brother,not realizing the danger of discovery is looming.
41000112431.title: Why Women Cheat

41000112468.name: Rising Dawn: The Awakening of Power
41000112468.synopsis: Aidan Stein, the Eternal Lord Sovereign of the magnificent Eternity Palace, temporarily loses his memory and intelligence due to his 60-year cycle. He lives alone in Vertania until he encounters Jade Yule, who saves his life and becomes his wife. Years later, Jack Foley, an aristocrat of Vertania, develops an interest in Jade. He sends his men after Aidan, inadvertently triggering the resurgence of his memories and power.
41000112468.title: Rising Dawn: The Awakening of Power (DUBBED)

41000112601.name: Got Myself A Priceless Husband
41000112601.synopsis: Beth Alison, after one fateful night with Norman Miles, runs into him again at a time of her need. Not remembering who he is, and not knowing the CEO identity that he has kept a secret from her, Beth goes on a journey of becoming a fashion designer and living a married life that eventually reveals a past and a man she thought she’s long left behind.
41000112601.title: Got Myself A Priceless Husband

41000112603.name: Before the Divorce: My CEO Husband Can't Get Enough of Me
41000112603.synopsis: Sophia is set up for a one-night stand with a man, only to find out that the man she had sex with last night is her husband, Matthew Soro. Unexpectedly, Matthew does not recognize Sophia as his wife, whom he has not seen for three years after getting a marriage license. Sophia is already a PR manager and meets Matthew again while collaborating on a project.
41000112603.title: Before the Divorce: My CEO Husband Can't Get Enough of Me

41000112750.name: Let It Be Me
41000112750.synopsis: Charlotte's parents passed away, and she was adopted by her uncle and aunt. As they grew older, her uncle arranged for Charlotte to marry Mike from the Davis family for the sake of a business partnership. In reality, Mike is a playboy and often has sexual relations with Ella. Upon discovering this, Charlotte angrily cancels her engagement with Mike and marries a homeless man named Jackson whom she found on the street.
41000112750.title: Let It Be Me

41000112807.name: Food, Love, Robots
41000112807.synopsis: Seven years after her soulmate Elliot’s sudden death, Lily’s quiet Christmas is upended when her and Elliot’s son Evan’s wish comes true: Elliot returns. But this Elliot is a humanoid robot, programmed with her late boyfriend’s memories. As Lily’s heart reopens to love, she must navigate the charming chaos of family, romance, and technology, discovering whether this second chance at happiness is real or just a perfect AI program.
41000112807.title: Food, Love, Robots

41000112822.name: The CEO’s Baby Mama
41000112822.synopsis: Vanessa Scott, a young woman struggling to save her sick sister, agrees to be a surrogate for a wealthy, enigmatic CEO, Alexander Moore. Unbeknownst to both, fate intertwines their lives further when Van unknowingly becomes Alex’s assistant. As secrets unravel and tensions rise, their growing attraction is threatened by misunderstandings, family pressure, and hidden pasts. Will love emerge from their tangled fates, or will deception tear them apart?
41000112822.title: The CEO’s Baby Mama

41000112841.name: The Choices of Fate
41000112841.synopsis: After their mother’s death, Kate and Amelia Morse face a cruel choice—only one can leave with their grieving grandmother. Believing wealth awaits, Amelia departs, only to find an ordinary life. Years later, envy consumes her when Kate marries into the wealthy Warren family. In a fit of rage, she kills her sister before taking her own life.
41000112841.title: The Choices of Fate

41000113005.name: His Sweet Bella
41000113005.synopsis: A young woman becomes a nanny for a powerful mafia boss's niece, only to be pulled into his world of crime, danger, and forbidden desire. As secrets surface and enemies close in, she must fight for survival while resisting a man who could either protect her or destroy her completely.
41000113005.title: His Sweet Bella

41000113458.name: Billionaire Alpha Won’t Let Me Go
41000113458.synopsis: Zoe Lopez returns to New York with her young son and crosses paths with Alexander Blackwood, a past lover—and a werewolf. As old feelings resurface, buried secrets of power, family, and supernatural heritage threaten their lives. With danger looming, their intense romance reignites, forcing them to face a fate beyond their control.
41000113458.title: Billionaire Alpha Won’t Let Me Go

41000113604.name: Fated to My Neighbor Boss
41000113604.synopsis: After a one-night stand with Ethan, Sherry gives birth to twins. Katrina, her wicked stepsister, steals one of the babies, pretends to be his mother, and becomes Ethan’s fiancee. Six years later, Sherry returns as a famous perfumer Siren, exposes Katrina’s lies, reunites with her stolen child, and falls in love with Ethan.
41000113604.title: Fated to My Neighbor Boss

41000113674.name: My Love, Out of Service
41000113674.synopsis: For five years, Finn Carter has silently fulfilled a contract signed with Renee Lane's mother—to heal her daughter's shattered heart. Day by day, he builds a life with a woman who sees him as nothing more than a placeholder for her first love. When Mike Smith's return coincides with the contract's end, Finn recognizes his cue to exit the stage of Renee's life.
41000113674.title: My Love, Out of Service

41000113684.name: Breaking off to Fall In Love
41000113684.synopsis: Edward and Bella, childhood sweethearts torn apart by fate, reunite years later. Now a successful lawyer, Bella is unknowingly arranged to marry Edward. Seeking to escape the unwanted marriage, Edward hires Bella to dissolve the contract, unaware she is his bride-to-be. Though Edward recognizes her soon, she believes he is someone else and reveals she is engaged. Choosing to protect her from afar, Edward hides his feelings. Will they finally fall in love again?
41000113684.title: Breaking off to Fall In Love

41000113766.name: You Were My Everything, Once
41000113766.synopsis: As a token of gratitude, Morgan White agrees to Lily Oswald's grandfather’s request, hiding his true identity as a researcher and marrying into the Oswald family as Lily’s seemingly ordinary husband. For eight years, he tenderly cares for Lily and their child, but her heart remains with her first love, Brett Oswald.
41000113766.title: You Were My Everything, Once

41000113988.name: The Longlost Heiress's Return
41000113988.synopsis: Nova Park is lost due to an accident, and her mother Zoe Park, determined to find her, establishes the world’s largest conglomerate and offers a huge reward. Finally, she receives news of her daughter at a medical laboratory. However, when she arrives, she witnesses her daughter's dignity being crushed by opportunists. Determined, Zoe vows to teach them a harsh lesson.
41000113988.title: The Longlost Heiress's Return

41000114331.name: I Became Mrs Grayson by Bragging
41000114331.synopsis: On the day of the interview, Alice, an ordinary girl, saved the CEO of the Grayson pharmaceutical group, and bragged that she was the CEO's financee. Unexpectedly, the CEO not only asked her to be his personal assistant, but also married her in a flash.
41000114331.title: I Became Mrs Grayson by Bragging

41000114449.name: Married My CEO Ex In My 40s
41000114449.synopsis: Mary Larson, a hardworking housekeeper in her 40s, attends her high school reunion, where she reconnects with James Hastings, her wealthy first love who has never stopped regretting their separation. As old feelings resurface, Mary struggles with self-doubt, the weight of her past, and the secret that her son might be James's child.
41000114449.title: Married My CEO Ex In My 40s

41000114452.name: Surprise! Baby Daddy Is The CEO
41000114452.synopsis: Kind and resilient Cristy quickly marries 'impotent' Leo after his secret millionaire mother, Lisa, arranges the match. Little does she know, Leo is the CEO of a large company and the father of her children, setting her on a path to unexpected luxuries and life-altering revelations.
41000114452.title: Surprise! Baby Daddy Is The CEO

41000114469.name: Hubby, Show Me The Money
41000114469.synopsis: Elaine Franklin, pressured into an arranged marriage, impulsively weds stranger Vincent after sabotaging her blind date. Unbeknownst to her, Vincent—secretly CEO of rival Jones Corp—recognizes her as his long-lost love. They maintain façades: she hides her film-director identity ("Andrea"), he conceals his wealth. By chance, the fascinating story unfolds...
41000114469.title: Hubby, Show Me The Money

41000114537.name: Alpha's Fated Surrogate
41000114537.synopsis: Leah becomes a surrogate to help her boyfriend but is betrayed. She meets Alpha Lucas, her fated mate. Pregnant and heartbroken, she enters the werewolf world and rises as Luna through love and strength.
41000114537.title: Alpha's Fated Surrogate

41000114644.name: Goodbye, My Once and Forever
41000114644.synopsis: Wendy Jensen, a wealthy heiress, begins a relationship with Jerry Hale in college and makes a five-year bet with her parents. She never expects betrayal. Yet, in the fifth year, Jerry brings home his assistant, Tina Sutton. While Wendy is asleep, Tina gives Wendy’s son a glass of wine. Furious, Wendy demands accountability, but Jerry defends Tina, telling Wendy not to overreact. Torn and heartbroken, Wendy decides to file for divorce.
41000114644.title: Goodbye, My Once and Forever

41000114682.name: Mr. Delaney: Tempted by My Sugar Daddy
41000114682.synopsis: When Bella chooses to go stripping to save her bedridden brother and is humiliated by her peers, she meets her hero, the gentlemanly and handsome tycoon Mr. Delaney, who offers her the chance to become his sugar baby in her most desperate moment of helplessness and despair. But will this be a salvation, or will it lead her to desire and danger?
41000114682.title: Mr. Delaney: Tempted by My Sugar Daddy

41000114695.name: Racing to My Heart
41000114695.synopsis: Zoey, a janitor for a racing team, finds herself betrayed and exploited by her husband, James. As she seeks a way out, James proves unwilling to grant her an easy divorce. In her moments of need, her boss, the renowned NASCAR champion Justin, steps in to assist. Their shared trials spark a growing affection between them. Just as they grapple with revealing their feelings, Justin discovers that Zoey is, in fact, his long-lost childhood sweetheart.
41000114695.title: Racing to My Heart

41000114850.name: Love Rooted in the Fields
41000114850.synopsis: At twenty-four, Cary West is forced to marry a stranger in a remote village to replace her sister, Katy, who is favored by their father. To her shock, her husband, Simon Zimmer, turns out to be the richest man in Oceana, and her mother-in-law, Muse Keller, showers her with care. However, Katy and her husband, Howard Gibson, continue to bully Cary and her family.
41000114850.title: Love Rooted in the Fields

41000114890.name: Boxer Boss Can't Get Enough
41000114890.synopsis: UFC champ Leo saves a shy florist from danger—and ends up spending one unforgettable night with her. She vanishes, only to return as his maid… and his contract lover. Cold, rich, and used to control, Leo never expected to fall. But as jealousy flares and a rival socialite schemes, Sela walks away—pregnant and heartbroken. Now Leo must chase the woman who changed everything.
41000114890.title: Boxer Boss Can't Get Enough

41000115012.name: Seducing Mr. Sterling: The Ice-cold Heir
41000115012.synopsis: To save her dying sister, Emma agrees to seduce ruthless CEO Ethan Sterling and ruin his reputation. But as she enters his world of power and secrets, she finds herself falling for the man she was meant to destroy. Torn between love and betrayal, Emma must choose: her sister's life—or the man who just might save her own.
41000115012.title: Seducing Mr. Sterling: The Ice-cold Heir

41000115048.name: Marry Again My Billionaire Ex
41000115048.synopsis: After a tragic crash kills her parents, Alexandra Grey assumes a new identity Adrianna for safety. Years later, Lucien, the man she married for protection, asks for a divorce. Heartbroken, she reclaims her true self and returns to take her father‘s company. But claiming her CEO title requires fulfilling a secret arranged marriage—to Lucien. As the danger escalates, he becomes her unlikely ally, and ultimately, her love.
41000115048.title: Marry Again My Billionaire Ex

41000115287.name: My Love, Out of Service
41000115287.synopsis: For five years, Finn Carter has silently fulfilled a contract signed with Renee Lane's mother—to heal her daughter's shattered heart. Day by day, he builds a life with a woman who sees him as nothing more than a placeholder for her first love. When Mike Smith's return coincides with the contract's end, Finn recognizes his cue to exit the stage of Renee's life.
41000115287.title: My Love, Out of Service (DUBBED)

41000115566.name: Fifty Shades of My Professor
41000115566.synopsis: To save her dreams, Shannon agrees to auction her virginity—only to fall into the arms of a man tangled in every corner of her life: her piano professor, her aunt’s fiancé... and her late mother’s forbidden love.
41000115566.title: Fifty Shades of My Professor

41000115707.name: For Love and Nothing Less
41000115707.synopsis: Seven years ago, Luna Sawyer was pregnant when she discovered that her boyfriend, Samuel Payne—who was battling cancer—was secretly the heir to Payne Corp in Reydon. Samuel was offered a deal: if he broke up with Luna, they would pay for his treatment. But deeply in love with her, he rejected the offer, unaware that Luna had overheard the conversation. Determined not to hold Samuel back, Luna silently chose to leave—only to be presumed dead in a car accident.
41000115707.title: For Love and Nothing Less

41000115756.name: A Virgin Surrogate for the Billionaire
41000115756.synopsis: Honey Myers becomes a surrogate for NFL star Tristan Brown to pay for her sister's surgery, navigating through challenges, betrayal, and unexpected love, ultimately finding happiness and family together despite numerous obstacles and threats from Tristan's ex-fiancée, Jennifer.
41000115756.title: A Virgin Surrogate for the Billionaire

41000115843.name: Shh... We Are A Secret
41000115843.synopsis: In a world where loyalty clashes with temptation, a rebellious heir and his alluring new stepsister navigate dangerous power struggles, family betrayals, and a forbidden romance—risking everything to protect their secrets and each other.
41000115843.title: Shh... We Are A Secret

41000116276.name: My Mile High Billionaire Obsession
41000116276.synopsis: Aaron's younger brother impersonates him to date and gets engaged to Harper—just to trick her into donating a kidney to the girl he really loves. Heartbroken, Aaron leaves the country for three years, believing Harper chose his brother. But just as Harper is about to go through with the donation, Aaron returns and uncovers the shocking truth. This time, he’s determined to win back the girl who was always his.
41000116276.title: My Mile High Billionaire Obsession

41000116448.name: The Captain's Baby Girl
41000116448.synopsis: After being abused and kicked out by her aunt, 18-year-old Lexie is rescued by her late father's best friend, Ethan, a wealthy and handsome pilot. As he becomes her guardian, their bond grows from protective care to forbidden desire. Through school bullying, career challenges, and romantic tension, Lexie blossoms—and so does their taboo love.
41000116448.title: The Captain's Baby Girl

41000116575.name: Mafia's Captive Bride
41000116575.synopsis: Mafia boss Sebastian forces Elena into a marriage after she saves his life at her mother's grave. Elena, trapped by Sebastian, fights back, tames him, and falls in love amidst crises.
41000116575.title: Mafia's Captive Bride

41000116643.name: Divorced at the Wedding Day
41000116643.synopsis: Alessia DeLuca returns home after years abroad, widowed and pregnant, to attend her brother Enzo's engagement party. A misunderstanding occurs when Caroline, the bride-to-be's mother, mistakes Alessia for Enzo's mistress. Sophie, the bride, storms into Enzo's mansion and physically confronts Alessia. She drags Alessia to the engagement party, humiliating her in front of the guests. The situation escalates until Enzo arrives to reveal the truth.
41000116643.title: Divorced at the Wedding Day

41000116675.name: The Rejected Luna is the Alpha
41000116675.synopsis: Athena's world shatters after losing her pack and mate. A year later, she regains her powers and demands a divorce from Victor, who brings his lover Selene to claim Athena's pack. With Alpha King Cassian's help, Athena fights back. As Victor and Selene's wedding implodes, Athena exposes Selene's lies and alliance with vampires. After a fierce battle, Athena reclaims her honor, restores her legacy, and finds love again with Cassian.
41000116675.title: The Rejected Luna is the Alpha

41000116783.name: The Hockey Star's Remorse
41000116783.synopsis: Six years ago, nerdy Evie spent a magical night with her crush, hockey star Timothy—only to learn it was all a bet. Now a successful producer, she crosses paths with him again. In front of reporters, Timothy publicly apologizes and reveals he's been waiting for Evie ever since. Within an hour, #FindEvie is trending at number one.
41000116783.title: The Hockey Star's Remorse

41000116844.name: My Online Crush Is My Contract Husband
41000116844.synopsis: A quirky nurse unknowingly falls for her billionaire boss through an anonymous dating app. When fate forces them into a contract marriage to fulfill his grandfather's dying wish, their online crush and real-life tension collide. Between steamy misunderstandings, family drama, and sweet chaos, love may just find its way—on and off the screen.
41000116844.title: My Online Crush Is My Contract Husband

41000116865.name: Mafia's 90-Day Bride
41000116865.synopsis: Gigi, seeking revenge on the insurance CEO who caused her father's death, offers her only $10,000 to mafia boss Vito to buy his life. Amused by her persistence, Vito proposes she become his bride for 90 days instead. Though he protects her, Vito's cynical nature leads him to refuse life-saving cancer surgery. Disheartened, Gigi believes she's just a pawn. When Gigi nearly miscarries, Vito realizes his love and chooses to fight for life to protect her and their child.
41000116865.title: Mafia's 90-Day Bride

41000117286.name: Infertile Alpha's Pregnant Mate
41000117286.synopsis: She breaks his curse of infertility and childlessness. He showers her with all the love in the world, spoiling her endlessly.
41000117286.title: Infertile Alpha's Pregnant Mate

41000117506.name: A Choice That Breaks Us
41000117506.synopsis: Nadia discovers she's pregnant with Renzo's child, but his mafia father forces her to break up with him to save his life. Years later, they reunite under hostile circumstances, with Renzo now engaged to another woman. As secrets unravel—including their daughter's leukemia and Diana's schemes—Renzo learns the truth. After rescuing Nadia and their child from Diana, they reconcile and vow to stay together as a family.
41000117506.title: A Choice That Breaks Us

41000117514.name: The Rejected Alpha Queen Comes Back
41000117514.synopsis: Lucia, the Alpha Queen, returns to her home pack as a wolfless commoner to reunite with her mate, Frederick, only to discover his betrayal.
