42000021679.synopsis: Years ago, Ava secretly sacrificed everything to save her sick lover, Ethan, and pretended to be a gold digger to force him home for treatment. Five years later, their son Noah died saving Ethan's grandmother. Humiliated by Ethan's fiancée while Ethan remained blind to the truth, Ava finally revealed everything. Ethan deeply regretted his actions, but Ava refused to forgive him.
42000021679.title: Stitched Hearts to the Billionaire’s Late Regret

42000021680.name: Hooking A CEO Daddy for Mommy
42000021680.synopsis: Julian Morgan, a cold billionaire heir, is forced to produce an heir—but the only woman he ever wanted disappeared after a one-night stand. Then a boy appears... with his face. "Be my son. I'll pay you." "Deal. But my mom can't know." A perfect secret—until Julian meets the boy's mother working in his factory... and realizes she's the woman he's been searching for.
42000021680.title: Hooking A CEO Daddy for Mommy

42000021919.name: Shifter Academy: Taming Three Wild Mates
42000021919.synopsis: What could possibly go wrong when a human girl spends mating season at a school full of apex predators? Everything. Ivy only wanted to finish her education. Instead, her scholarship to Shifter Academy comes with a catch: she's the fated mate of not one, not two, but three of the strongest shifters on campus: Ronan, Leon and Talon. Three alphas. One impossible choice. Her heart has chosen. It's love at first slap.
42000021919.title: Shifter Academy: Taming Three Wild Mates

42000022499.name: A Dare to Kiss My Bad Boy
42000022499.synopsis: Avery Parker transfers to elite Crestwood School hoping to reunite with her childhood crush, Nathan. Instead, a humiliating accident makes her the target of campus gossip and brings her into constant conflict with Jaxson Hale, the school's notorious bad boy. As bullying, secrets, and rivalries unravel, Avery discovers Nathan isn't who she imagined, while Jax's unexpected loyalty challenges everything she believes about love, trust, and second chances.
42000022499.title: A Dare to Kiss My Bad Boy

42000023322.name: Bridal Revenge Served Cold
42000023322.synopsis: After CEO Luca quickly gets engaged to his billionaire investor Minka, his family, led by his greedy sister Camilla, mistakes her for a mistress. They end up humiliating and abusing her at the rehearsal dinner, trying to protect the money they think they're about to get, until the truth comes out and everything turns into revenge.
42000023322.title: Bridal Revenge Served Cold

42000023486.name: Nanny to the Mafia Single Daddy
42000023486.synopsis: Mafia godfather Victor closes his heart off to love after the unexpected death of his wife. But when Jennifer, his daughter's nanny, enters his life, he finds himself losing control and giving in to feelings he never expected. As their passionate push-and-pull romance unfolds, the two must overcome misunderstandings and survive brushes with death before finally finding their way to each other.
42000023486.title: Nanny to the Mafia Single Daddy

42000023802.name: He Broke the Heart That Saved Him
42000023802.synopsis: Mia sacrifices everything for her dying lover Vance, never knowing he is Cloud City's greatest heir. To return the future to him, Mia walks away resolutely without telling him she's pregnant. Years later, their child's tragic fate crosses their paths again. Yet vicious lies turn him against her, driving their boy to his death. Since then, Mia has lived in the pain of losing her son, while Vance, upon discovering the truth, will be left to bear the crushing weight of regret.
42000023802.title: He Broke the Heart That Saved Him

42000024002.name: My Ex's Brother Teaches Me to Puck
42000024002.synopsis: When med student Lily gets dumped for being "the most unfuckable girl on campus," she teams up with her ex’s brother, Mason Clark, to learn the art of "sex appeal." However, as their lessons draw them closer emotionally as well as physically, Lily realizes Mason was the one all along. But when her ex discovers she’s moved on, the rivalry between the brothers explodes. Will the brothers be able to mend their bond and Lily be with Mason? Or will her ex tear them apart?
42000024002.title: My Ex's Brother Teaches Me to Puck

42000024788.name: Wet Hot Summer with the Boy I Lost
42000024788.synopsis: On the last day of school, Skye bets her biggest bully she'll lose her virginity to the hottest guy, Luke, over the summer. But shy Skye has never even been kissed. When her irresistibly hot neighbor Grayson offers to teach her how to win Luke over, sparks fly between them instead. Soon, Skye realizes the one guy she swore she'd never want is the one she can't resist.
42000024788.title: Wet Hot Summer with the Boy I Lost

42000025226.name: Poisoned by His Love
42000025226.synopsis: On her half-sister Victoria's wedding day, 25-year-old nurse Lily Watson is forced into a deadly bargain. Victoria is set to marry Dominic Castellano, a ruthless mafia king rumored to have killed his last wife. But when Victoria flees, Dominic's hitmen threaten Lily's family. To protect them, Lily takes Victoria's place at the altar and becomes the bride of a man she fears may be a killer.
42000025226.title: Poisoned by His Love

42000025240.name: Kneel Before The Dragon Queen
42000025240.synopsis: After seven years in hiding, Dragon Queen Veya returns disguised as a humble healer, only to be betrayed and humiliated by the man she once loved. When she enters a marriage of convenience with powerful Duke Kael Frostwing, her enemies mistake her for a powerless commoner—until Veya reveals her true identity and reclaims her throne.
42000025240.title: Kneel Before The Dragon Queen

42000025978.name: Forbidden Fling With My Bestie's Dad
42000025978.synopsis: After catching her fiancé cheating on the flight to her best friend's tropical wedding, grad student Mia drunkenly hooks up with Damien, a mysterious silver-fox billionaire, only to discover he's the bride's father. Forced to hide their forbidden attraction throughout a chaotic wedding weekend, they face jealous exes, secret encounters, and vengeful sabotage that could destroy the ceremony.
42000025978.title: Forbidden Fling With My Bestie's Dad

42000026689.name: Sorry, No Dragon Heiress Here
42000026689.synopsis: Sera is the lowest servant at a dragon riders' academy—a girl whose blood is so tainted that no dragon would ever choose her. But when that same "poison" blood hatches the legendary Sovereign dragon egg, the powerless maid becomes the most dangerous woman in the realm. Now hunted by the very lords who once spat on her, Sera must claim a destiny written in blood—and make every enemy who wronged her pay.
42000026689.title: Sorry, No Dragon Heiress Here

42000027479.name: Never Mess With The Undercover Queen Bee
42000027479.synopsis: At St. Martin's High, the wealthy students have a sick game called the Charity Case Roulette-they randomly pick a broke girl as their prey, chasing her for a month to make her fall in love, only to publicly dump and humiliate her. The new charity case, Audrey, is chosen by the school's King Lucas as his latest target. However, what no one knows is that Audrey is actually the sole heiress to the elite Martin Group and the true Chair of the school board.
42000027479.title: Never Mess With The Undercover Queen Bee

42000028173.name: Love Is A Dangerous Game
42000028173.synopsis: Olivia is dragged by her husband Ryan to a couples-swapping getaway—only to be paired with Jake, the husband of her closest friend Mia. Jake is magnetic, unreadable, relentless—nothing like the dull, clueless husband Mia always described. And he won't stop closing in. As both men begin fighting for Olivia's attention, and Mia's jealousy cracks in her perfect act, Olivia must uncover the real truth behind the partner-swapping party before it's too late.
42000028173.title: Love Is A Dangerous Game

42000030222.name: My Nonstop Chatter Unlocked Autistic Stepbrother's World
42000030222.synopsis: Eight-year-old Clara never stops talking, but in her new stepfamily's silent mansion, her chatter is treated like a curse. Four-year-old Tommy, her autistic stepbrother, hasn't spoken in two years—until Clara's gentle stories reach him. As Tommy slowly finds his voice, Clara must challenge a family that mistakes silence for safety and prove that sometimes, being heard begins with someone willing to keep talking.
42000030222.title: My Nonstop Chatter Unlocked Autistic Stepbrother's World

42000024547.title: My Billionaire Patient Is My Baby Daddy
42000024547.name: My Billionaire Patient Is My Baby Daddy
42000024547.synopsis: Ella is tricked by her divorce-seeking husband Arthur into sleeping with a stranger on their wedding night, and later gives birth to twins, with one dumped on a hospital bench by him. Fisher, the stranger and a billionaire, finds him and raises him. Years later, Ella serves as Fisher's physical therapist in his estate, looking for her missing son. As the truth unravels, Ella finds her other son, and heals both him and Fisher. The family of four is eventually reunited.

42000023004.title: Werewolf Academy: Craving The Forbidden Alpha
42000023004.name: Werewolf Academy: Craving The Forbidden Alpha
42000023004.synopsis: One rule at Blackwood Academy: never touch Damien Blackthorne, the cursed Alpha heir. But when he touches Maya Whitefang — his rival's sister — their mate marks ignite. Now Maya must choose: the clan that owns her, or the dangerous Alpha whose wolf calms only for her.

42000027406.title: The Betrayed Wolfless Is The Lycan King
42000027406.name: The Betrayed Wolfless Is The Lycan King
42000027406.synopsis: Aeron gives his Alpha wolf to his beloved mate Serena to fulfill her dream. After she abandons him, he gains secret Lycan power blessed by the Moon Goddess. Years later, the ambitious Serena invades packs for dominance. Aeron must face his former lover, fight dark forces, and protect his new friends while hiding his true mighty identity.

42000027414.title: Claimed by My Boyfriend's Mafia Dad
42000027414.name: Claimed by My Boyfriend's Mafia Dad
42000027414.synopsis: Grace is drugged and framed by her jealous best friend Chloe at her boyfriend Ethan’s birthday party. Disoriented, she stumbles onto a hotel terrace and has a one-night stand with ruthless mafia don Vincent. Waking up, Grace is horrified to find this mysterious man is Ethan’s powerful father. She tries to forget the mistake and stay with Ethan, yet Vincent keeps drawing near. Where will this forbidden bond between Grace and Vincent lead...

42000027254.title: What If I'm One Hell of a Fighter
42000027254.name: What If I'm One Hell of a Fighter
42000027254.synopsis: After his father dies, Kane is taken in by Eve, a gym owner. Bullied as a janitor, he hides his skills until gangsters threaten the gym. Kane defeats them but is forced into an underground death match against the world champion—and wins, securing millions. Eve's kidnapped father is already dead. Kane avenges him. Months later, the gym thrives. Kane and Eve find family and purpose together.

42000024579.title: My Weak Little Dog Is a Legendary Sky Lion
42000024579.name: My Weak Little Dog Is a Legendary Sky Lion
42000024579.synopsis: Betrayed by her lover Corrin and best friend Ophelia, Amber was stripped of her bloodline and brutally murdered. Reborn on the day she chose her bonded beast, she refuses the powerful Corrin and instead bonds with a lowly white dog Aerion, who tried to save her in the past life and later reveals his true form—the legendary Sky Lion. Just as Amber begins her revenge against the betrayers, a darker conspiracy unfolds, revealing the ultimate mastermind pulling the strings.

42000026686.title: Get Out of My Bugatti
42000026686.name: Get Out of My Bugatti
42000026686.synopsis: Disguised as an ordinary employee, billionaire founder Ryan Carter lends his Bugatti to arrogant manager Bella. After she and her family steal, mock, and try to fire him, Ryan reveals his identity in the boardroom—and makes them answer for every cruel choice.

42000023840.title: Pregnant with the Dragon King's Triplets
42000023840.name: Pregnant with the Dragon King's Triplets
42000023840.synopsis: Sold by her family to abusive suitors for magical spring water, fox attendant Sylvia — thought unable to bear children — turns up pregnant with triplets after a night with a stranger who's secretly the Dragon King, Cassius. As he shields her from family, rivals, and jealous coworkers, an attack meant to kill her instead reveals she's the long-lost princess of the Nine-Tailed Wolf Clan. Villains fall; Cassius claims her as his queen.

42000026621.title: Your Dumped Housewife Is Your Boss
42000026621.name: Your Dumped Housewife Is Your Boss
42000026621.synopsis: Linda gave up her billionaire legacy for her husband Nick. A ransom call shatters her perfect life: Nick and their daughter have been kidnapped. Rushing to pay the ransom, she's forced to trade her freedom for Nick's mistress Claire. She endures three years of torture in a drug lab. When Linda finally escapes and returns as the billionaire heiress of the Hastings Group, she's ready to make everyone who betrayed her kneel at her feet.

42000027417.title: My Demon Lord, Your Shepherd Girl Has Run Away Again
42000027417.name: My Demon Lord, Your Shepherd Girl Has Run Away Again
42000027417.synopsis: Abandoned on an island by her father King John, Ingrid is summoned back when her stepmother Martha and stepsister Lilith covet her betrothal to Lucifer, the King of Hell. Scorned as an ignorant shepherdess, she can secretly communicate with all living things and wields great healing power. Lucifer disrupts her revenge: she once hid him, unaware of his identity, then fled. Seeing through her act, he grips her chin and claims her as his own. This time, he won't let her escape.

42000023914.title: Billionaire's Ugly Ex-Wife Is a Goddess
42000023914.name: Billionaire's Ugly Ex-Wife Is a Goddess
42000023914.synopsis: Chloe Ashford spent three years hiding behind an ugly disguise, believing her billionaire husband loved her soul. But when Ethan Sterling gives her anniversary gown to his first love, Chloe discovers she was only his weapon against his family. She unveils her true beauty, files for divorce, and rises as Vesper—a fashion genius no one can control. Now Ethan wants her back, but Chloe has learned: she doesn`t need a savior.

42000023820.title: The Lost Son of Zeus: His Return
42000023820.name: The Lost Son of Zeus: His Return
42000023820.synopsis: Hercules, the son of Zeus and Hera, goes missing as a child and is swapped with the mortal Icaris by an envious follower. Eighteen years later, Hercules travels to Olympus to join the Divine Guards to save his beloved, far outperforming Icaris. Unaware of his true identity, Zeus's family, instigated by Icaris, cruelly suppress and exile him. Once the truth is revealed, Zeus's family desperately begs for forgiveness, while Icaris conspires with Hades for revenge.

42000026723.title: Don't Mess With the XXL Girl
42000026723.name: Don't Mess With the XXL Girl
42000026723.synopsis: I spent five grueling years transforming from a mocked fat girl into an upcoming international model. My global debut lands at the same hotel as my high school bullies' reunion. Josephine, my tormentor, dug up a humiliating old video and tagged me, while classmates bet I'd never show. I replied calmly and vowed to arrive on time—and make them all pay.

42000026722.title: Wipe Out My Pack? A Dumb Pup Turned the Tables!
42000026722.name: Wipe Out My Pack? A Dumb Pup Turned the Tables!
42000026722.synopsis: Mia Blackridge, the youngest daughter of Blackridge Pack's Alpha, is widely seen as a useless dumb pup who can't even shift into wolf form. Secretly, she is the reborn soul of a former Pack Alpha who ruled for 70 years. When the scheming Beta Grady forges a royal Crown Order to execute her father and wipe out the whole pack, Mia steps forward, exposes the fake seal, outplays the enemy forces with her lifelong wisdom, and saves her entire pack from ruin.

42000024553.title: No More Blood For My Vampire First Love
42000024553.name: No More Blood For My Vampire First Love
42000024553.synopsis: She gave him her heart, only to be used as a pawn to win her cruel stepsister. Shattered, the gifted Keeper Allie walks away—straight into the devotion of an ancient Original who has waited two centuries for her. Watching her reign alongside a far superior man, her ex falls to his knees begging for a second chance. Too late. She destroys her enemies and chooses true love, leaving the boy who broke her choking on regret.

42000028905.title: Chosen by the Dragon Baby: His Human Mate
42000028905.name: Chosen by the Dragon Baby: His Human Mate
42000028905.synopsis: After being betrayed, sold, and robbed of her newborn, Emery believes she has lost everything. A year later, she is accidentally saved from a human slaver by Alaric, the Dragon King, and serves as a maid in his palace. There, his silent daughter, Juno, rejects every shifter in the realm—but chooses Emery as "Mama." As Juno begins to heal and Alaric falls for Emery, the buried secrets reveal that their bond runs deeper than any of them imagined.

42000025241.title: Their Hidden Princess
42000025241.name: Their Hidden Princess
42000025241.synopsis: After a mysterious dream reveals two men who could be her fated mate, Princess Zora comes to Blackstone Academy with one mission: find her true love to avoid an arranged marriage. Posing as a wolfless nobody, she plans to keep a low profile. Instead she catches the attention of Maximus and Ethan, the most powerful Alpha best friends. When fate chooses one heart and temptation pulls toward another, Zora discovers that finding true love is a lot messier than destiny promised.

42000029145.title: Too Ugly to Marry, She's a Hidden Beauty!
42000029145.name: Too Ugly to Marry, She's a Hidden Beauty!
42000029145.synopsis: My Oscar dad and Grammy mom saw me as an ugly, unwanted daughter, called me Toad, and sent me to Grandma Maggie. 18 years later, I got into Harvard and came home masked. Dad frowned: "Hiding your ugly face?" Mom laughed, saying I'd look worse next to pretty Sienna. Sienna took my hand, calling beauty a burden and me "blessed to be ugly". My hand paused. Grandma wrote monthly—I got prettier daily, boys flocked. She sent pics. They never opened any, never knew what I'd become.

42000025248.title: Betrothed to a Beggar, Crowned a Dragon Queen
42000025248.name: Betrothed to a Beggar, Crowned a Dragon Queen
42000025248.synopsis: Betrayed by her fiancé and mocked by her family, Lyra chooses a penniless, hornless stranger as her destined mate. But "Ethan" is actually Aurelian, the legendary Dragon God in disguise. As jealous Astrid turns to forbidden magic and deadly enemies close in, Lyra must fight for love, dignity, and her true power—until the discarded daughter rises from humiliation to become the Dragon Queen.

42000023370.title: The Mafia Don’s Virgin Wife
42000023370.name: The Mafia Don’s Virgin Wife
42000023370.synopsis: Surgeon Mia, burdened by OCD, faces divorce from her husband. She enters a secret club to change herself. Mafia leader Nick sees her on stage and saves her from danger. A passionate forbidden love soon develops between them.

42000023596.title: The Dragon Lord Returns
42000023596.name: The Dragon Lord Returns
42000023596.synopsis: Once the feared Dragon Lord, Kael hides as a lowly car-wash worker after a devastating injury, secretly helping his wife Vexa rise to power. On the night he plans to reveal his identity, he discovers her affair with Riven, heir of House Vale, and is forced into divorce. Cast aside and ridiculed, Kael marries Nyx, the mysterious wheelchair-bound heiress of House Veyra, punishes those who offend them, and takes back the control of the galaxy.

42000025657.title: Mistaken for My Brother-in-law's Sex Doll
42000025657.name: Mistaken for My Brother-in-law's Sex Doll
42000025657.synopsis: Lucy, a pawn in an arranged marriage, is betrayed by her husband and stepsister. One night, mafia boss Ethan mistakes her for a sex doll. Under his cold domination, she awakens. She decides to become his perfect toy and use him to destroy everyone who betrayed her.

42000025323.title: Tit for Tat
42000025323.name: Tit for Tat
42000025323.synopsis: Hugo's wife Sophie is about to give birth. On the way to the hospital, they are forced off the road by wealthy brats. Hugo endures humiliation to protect her. But the brats have just brought ruin upon their own family, the Westons.

42000023264.title: Billionaire’s Sudden Wife
42000023264.name: Billionaire’s Sudden Wife
42000023264.synopsis: Evelyn, an IT genius, enters a contract marriage with billionaire CEO Landon to inherit her mother's estate. From a fake couple to true love, she uses her hacking skills to solve crises, grows in the high-society game, and ultimately wins love and family recognition.

42000022012.title: I'm Done Chasing A Brat!
42000022012.name: I'm Done Chasing A Brat!
42000022012.synopsis: Joe, secret heir to the Havv fortune, loves Tina—his chauffeur's daughter, a fake heiress who frames him as a rapist and drives him off a rooftop. He wakes reborn before it all began. This time he exposes her, strips away every luxury he ever bought her, and crowns kind-hearted Anna at a billion-dollar banquet where Tina's fraud collapses. When Joe proposes, Anna admits she never was reborn—she waited 125,600 years for him.

42000025980.title: The Pirate King's Virgin Princess
42000025980.name: The Pirate King's Virgin Princess
42000025980.synopsis: A runaway princess. A ruthless pirate king. When Yelena saves the wounded Cassian Thorn, she never expects to become the captive bride of the most dangerous man on the seas. Yet beneath his cold exterior lies a wounded heart, and their forced union slowly transforms into an unforgettable love.

42000025990.title: The Road Through Fire
42000025990.name: The Road Through Fire
42000025990.synopsis: Former Marine Luke Carter takes a $50,000 job escorting heiress Charlotte Morgan across the deadly Mojave Desert to pay for his comatose sister's care. Hunted by cartels, traffickers, and even Charlotte's uncle, the bickering pair fight to survive and slowly fall for each other. When Charlotte is betrayed and kidnapped, Luke risks everything to save her—and finish the journey they started together.

42000023826.title: The Substitue Groom is a Mafia Daddy
42000023826.name: The Substitue Groom is a Mafia Daddy
42000023826.synopsis: Burdened by her father's mountainous debt, Anna has no choice but to enter a forced marriage with Valentin, the ruthless, iron-fisted head of a powerful mafia financial empire. Cold, domineering, and accustomed to absolute control, he is a feared tyrant of the underworld—until a fateful accident leads Anna to his private BDSM chamber, pulling both of them into a tense, dangerous dance of desire and submission.

42000023815.title: Raise an Ancient King to Be My Boyfriend
42000023815.name: Raise an Ancient King to Be My Boyfriend
42000023815.synopsis: A mysterious holy chalice transforms modern girl Elena Moro into the savior of an ancient kingdom. By sending food, medicine, and modern knowledge across time, she saves the kingdom from ruin and becomes its goddess. But when Elena falls for its handsome young king, Varik, can their forbidden love bridge a three-thousand-year divide?

42000022009.title: The Fae Prince's Secret Heir
42000022009.name: The Fae Prince's Secret Heir
42000022009.synopsis: Six years after a fateful night with a masked stranger, Aria enters the Blood Elf palace with her son—unaware that Prince Lucian is the boy’s father. But mistaken identities and an ancient dragon marriage pact threaten to keep them apart.

42000022998.title: The Lost Monster Hunter Returns
42000022998.name: The Lost Monster Hunter Returns
42000022998.synopsis: When ten-year-old Erling, the son of legendary hunter Karl, is kidnapped during a beast raid, his memories are erased with a forbidden elixir and he is replaced by another boy. Renamed Viggo, he grows up as an abused thrall while the imposter Gunnar is raised as Karl's beloved heir. Eight years later, Viggo enters the Hunter Trials to win his freedom, unaware he is fighting beside the father who has searched for him for years.

42000025234.title: Bound by the Cursed Alpha King
42000025234.name: Bound by the Cursed Alpha King
42000025234.synopsis: After a betrayed Omega servant is publicly humiliated at the royal Marriage Rite, the cursed Alpha King claims her as his Luna to survive tonight's Blood Moon—but she is secretly his true fated mate, the lost Moonveil princess, and the only woman whose bond can contain the beast inside him before it finally breaks the curse.

42000022831.title: Offered to the Black Dragon, I Became the Holy-Blood Witch
42000022831.name: Offered to the Black Dragon, I Became the Holy-Blood Witch
42000022831.synopsis: Ivy, the cursed twin, is scorned; Lilia, the other twin, is adored. Caius the phoenix bonds with Ivy but gives his heartfeather to Lilia and forces Ivy to die in Lilia's place before the black dragon. Yet dragon Adrian recognizes Ivy, who saved him as a child. Her blood cleanses his blight, revealing her as the Holy-Blood Witch. Now the world worships Ivy; Caius begs her with his last heartfeather, while Adrian refuses to let her go. Ivy must choose: guilt or love.

42000022999.title: The Last Whitemoon Alpha King
42000022999.name: The Last Whitemoon Alpha King
42000022999.synopsis: Raised an orphan with nothing but a marriage pact made by parents he never knew, Rourke is bound to rabbit-clan heiress Lyra Warrenhold and pulled into a brutal succession war. He soon discovers the betrothal was no coincidence — he's the last living heir of the Whitemoon Alpha King who was butchered by the very predator empire he must now stand against to protect Lyra, avenge his parents, and reclaim a throne soaked in his family's blood.

42000029180.title: Forbidden Fall of the Wife
42000029180.name: Forbidden Fall of the Wife
42000029180.synopsis: Vivian, a young and beautiful wife, has had no intimacy with her wealthy, perpetually absent husband Carl for nearly two years. Desperate to reignite his desire, she binds herself on the living room sofa as a surprise for his homecoming — only to be mistaken by her eighteen-year-old stepson Lucas for a high-end sex doll.

42000023251.title: Rejected by My Alpha, Claimed by the Lycan King
42000023251.name: Rejected by My Alpha, Claimed by the Lycan King
42000023251.synopsis: On the day of her engagement, Ava discovers her Alpha fiancé cheating with her stepsister, and is publicly rejected and cast out of the pack. In despair, she stumbles into the car of the mysterious billionaire Caden—unaware that this man is none other than the Lycan King, feared by all werewolves, and that she herself is the fated queen he has been searching for all along.

42000022175.title: Rejected as Barren,Claimed by the Lycan King
42000022175.name: Rejected as Barren,Claimed by the Lycan King
42000022175.synopsis: Barren and rejected by her mate, Hailey is sold by her father to the feared Lycan King, rumored to kill his brides on full moon nights. But after she rescues a poisoned silver wolf pup, she discovers he is the king’s beloved heir—and that the ruthless tyrant may be her fated mate. In NorthRidge, buried lies, a cursed king, and a stolen destiny await.

42000026800.title: Second Chance as Her Mr.Trash
42000026800.name: Second Chance as Her Mr.Trash
42000026800.synopsis: Cory Judd has had a crush on Zoe Stone for as long as he can remember. Just before graduating from college, he finally confesses—and she accepts him. While celebrating, he gets drunk. But when he wakes up, he finds himself seven years in the future. Not only is he married to Zoe, but he's also ruined their marriage. Zoe is disappointed in him, and their child suffers from psychological trauma that leaves them unable to speak.

42000026703.title: Hired as a Lucky Charm, This Cowgirl Defended My Autistic Stepson
42000026703.name: Hired as a Lucky Charm, This Cowgirl Defended My Autistic Stepson
42000026703.synopsis: Cowgirl Maddie is hired by the wealthy Ashford family as a so-called lucky charm to pay off her late father's ranch debts. She becomes Elias's nominal new wife, tasked with calming his autistic five-year-old stepson Liam. Inside the fancy Beverly Hills mansion, Maddie discovers Liam has long suffered secret abuse from hypocritical tutor Sophia, while the whole family turns a blind eye to the boy's pain.

42000022014.title: The Hundredth Oath
42000022014.name: The Hundredth Oath
42000022014.synopsis: To safeguard the Kingdom of Avaloria, Loki renounces his divinity. Honoring the late king's last will, he vows to help the young Queen Freya rule the kingdom and forgive her a hundred times. Manipulated by Surt, Freya gradually strips Loki of his authority, military command, and dignity. Upon the hundredth betrayal, Loki fulfills the pact. He relinquishes all that remains of his station, hands over the annulment of their betrothal, and resolves to leave the royal court...

42000025982.title: Kneel! That's the Dragon Rider
42000025982.name: Kneel! That's the Dragon Rider
42000025982.synopsis: After secretly saving the continent, legendary Silver Dragon Rider Arthur returns to his fiancée, only to find she has chosen an Elven noble instead—just as the Elven Queen who has spent years searching for him becomes the target of a conspiracy that could destroy her reign.

42000023772.title: They Messed With the Wrong Heiress
42000023772.name: They Messed With the Wrong Heiress
42000023772.synopsis: On her birthday, Danielle, the low-key heiress of the Sterling Group, saves an injured old woman, only to be blackmailed by her and humiliated by her greedy children. At Danielle’s gala, they mock her as poor, unaware her father Richard is watching. He exposes their lies, crushes their schemes, and rescues Danielle from a kidnapping plot. In the end, Richard gives up his empire for a peaceful life with his daughter.

42000025984.title: My Trash Pup Is Fenrir
42000025984.name: My Trash Pup Is Fenrir
42000025984.synopsis: Rayne, a mysterious beast tamer raised in the mountains, returns to civilization with his scruffy stray dog, Max. When he reunites with Elena—the girl he promised to marry fourteen years ago—he discovers she is now engaged to a powerful nobleman. As the Barbarians threaten her city, Rayne must uncover his true identity, awaken Max’s hidden power, and protect the woman he never stopped loving.

42000026687.title: The Zero-Talent Nanny Raised Beast Kings
42000026687.name: The Zero-Talent Nanny Raised Beast Kings
42000026687.synopsis: Thrown into a beast-filled alien world with zero magic or combat skills, preschool teacher Mia Harper must save a notorious, nearly bankrupt academy—or lose her soul. Her students are five powerful cubs branded dangerous, unwanted, or uncontrollable. As ruthless nobles, corrupt officials, and old scandals threaten to tear them apart, Mia fights to protect the children, rebuild their broken school, and prove that care can be stronger than any bloodline.

42000025315.title: After His 99 Mistresses, I Took His Empire
42000025315.name: After His 99 Mistresses, I Took His Empire
42000025315.synopsis: Elena marries into the elite Cole family. For five years, she cleans up her playboy husband Ryan's scandals with 99 mistresses while quietly laying her plan to seize power. When his 100th mistress Mia wins his full devotion and grows ruthless, pregnant Elena is shoved into premature birth—but Ryan takes Mia's side completely, shattering all pretense.

42000027421.title: Level One Loser, Maxxx Level Lover
42000027421.name: Level One Loser, Maxxx Level Lover
42000027421.synopsis: Cole, a broke and overlooked gamer, gets sucked into the fantasy RPG he's playing and unlocks a mysterious leveling system that transforms his fate. Suddenly a party hero everyone respects, Cole's fortunes change dramatically as three battle-forged beauties vie for his heart.

42000027933.title: Called Me a Gold Digger? So Why Is He Begging?
42000027933.name: Called Me a Gold Digger? So Why Is He Begging?
42000027933.synopsis: For three years, Freda endures being called a gold digger while her billionaire boyfriend, Victor, stands by in silence. When he questions her love once again, she ends their engagement and leaves for a three-year overseas assignment. Only after she is gone does Victor uncover the truth—and realize how deeply he failed her. Now he will do anything to win her back, but Freda may have already moved on.

42000025209.title: Fate of the Dragon’s Bride
42000025209.name: Fate of the Dragon’s Bride
42000025209.synopsis: Lydia is forced to marry the "savage" Dragon King Lucian. She flees and meets a dragon-shifter, giving him her virginity. She becomes pregnant, is captured and put on trial. Lucian discovers she is the woman who saved him and descends to claim her as his only bride.

42000024067.title: The Hidden Heiress of Beastmaster Academy
42000024067.name: The Hidden Heiress of Beastmaster Academy
42000024067.synopsis: Vera, the true princess of the Stellar Kingdom, disguised herself as a common apprentice at the Beastmaster Academy to escape the royal court. She faced the fake princess Selene who stole her identity. With royal blood and ancient sacred beast Dusty, she fought back, revealed the truth, and rose from student to ruler who protected the continent.

42000024385.title: Hearing Thoughts The Billionaire Family Spoils Me
42000024385.name: Hearing Thoughts The Billionaire Family Spoils Me
42000024385.synopsis: Chloe, the strongest angel, is banished to Earth and possesses the lost heiress of the White family. She discovers her inner thoughts can be heard by her family and heir Lucian. With this ability, she exposes the fake heiress Nicole's schemes, falls in love with Lucian, and chooses to stay human, gaining love and a family.

42000024834.title: Billionaire Luna: Taming My Alpha Mates
42000024834.name: Billionaire Luna: Taming My Alpha Mates
42000024834.synopsis: Aria, a princess, is transmigrated into a world where she is despised by her four alpha mates. She gains a spending system that doubles her returns. She exposes plots, rescues her mates, and awakens SSS golden bloodline. She destroys the black tide organization, purifies the world tree, becomes queen, and brings peace.
